Die Natur war den Vorfahren der Germanen heilig. Ihre Kulte vollzogen sie an besonderen Orten unter freiem Himmel. Spuren dieser vor- und frühgeschichtlichen Kulte sind in ganz Deutschland zu finden. Die heiligen Haine der Kelten und Germanen liegen inmitten dichter Wälder, auf hohen Felsen oder am Rand von Flüssen und Mooren. Oft wurden sie mit christlichen Gebäuden überbaut. Wissenschaftler sind diesen heiligen Plätzen mit modernster Technik auf der Spur.

Die Autoren betreten die mythische Welt der "Frau Holle" und decken auf, wie die germanische Sagenfigur ins Märchen kam. Der Brunnen als Tor in die fantastische Welt der "Frau Holle". Sie belohnt die Fleißigen, bestraft die Faulen.

Märchen sind weit mehr als versponnene Geschichten. Die Dokumentation nimmt das Märchen Hänsel und Gretel unter die Lupe und entschlüsselt seinen historischen Kern. Hänsel und Gretel gilt als das deutscheste und bekannteste aller Grimm-Märchen.

Gerade feiert Constanze ihren achtzehnten Geburtstag, als sie unversehens auf ein streng gehütetes Geheimnis stößt. Sechs Brüder soll sie haben, die durch ein unbedachtes Wort des Vaters am Tage der Geburt ihrer Schwester in schneeweiße Schwäne verwandelt worden waren. Constanze ist fassungslos. Sie ist es umso mehr, als plötzlich und wie von Zauberhand geführt die sechs Schwäne erscheinen. Sie berichten ihrer Schwester, dass nur sie alleine den Fluch bezwingen kann.

Der zwölfjährige Jakob, ein hübscher und verträumter Junge, geht am liebsten seiner Mutter an ihrem Gemüsestand auf dem Markt zur Hand. Eines Tages erscheint dort eine hässliche alte Frau, die Fee Kräuterweis, die den Knaben mit einer List in ihr Haus lockt. Hier beginnt für ihn eine harte Lehrzeit, an deren Ende sich Jakob zu einem wahren Meister der Kochkunst entwickelt.

Ein falscher Prinz wird beim Diebstahl einer goldenen Kugel erwischt und in einen magischen Wald verbannt, wo ihn eine Fee ungewollt in einen Frosch verwandelt. Die Verzauberung kann nur durch den Kuss einer Prinzessin aufgehoben werden. Als der Frosch hilft, die Goldkugel aus einem tiefen Brunnen zu holen, beansprucht er eine Belohnung. Nun wird sich zeigen, ob er jetzt wirklich den für ihn so wichtigen Kuss erhält, der seinen Bann lösen kann.

Ein mutiges Schneewittchen und eine eigenwillige Zwergentruppe nehmen den Kampf mit der Königin auf. Viele Jahre hat die eitle Königin ihre Stieftochter vor den Augen der Welt verborgen. Doch als die Königin Schneewittchen gegen deren Willen mit dem reichen Grafen Sebald verheiraten will, sehen es alle: Schneewittchen ist schöner als die Königin. Das kann die Königin nicht ertragen und gibt ihrem Bruder Gilig den Befehl, Schneewittchen zu ermorden.

Ein Wanderzirkus zieht durch die verschneite Landschaft, als eine Lawine die Gaukler mit ihren Wagen unter sich begräbt. Der kleine Jakob konnte den Schneemassen mithilfe von Frau Holle entkommen. Die ihn in ihre Zauberwelt über den Wolken aufnimmt.

Laut einer Prophezeiung droht dem Königreich Unheil, wenn die Prinzessin nicht innerhalb eines Jahres heiratet. Doch die spielt dem verliebten Prinzen lieber Streiche. Als der sein Versprechen bricht, der Prinzessin ewig treu zu sein, verwandelt ihn die Fee in einen Frosch. Das Jahr geht dem Ende zu, und das Volk wird unruhig. Da verliert die Prinzessin ihren goldenen Ball, und ein seltsamer Frosch bietet ihr seine Hilfe an.

Es ist Liebe auf den ersten Blick: Die schöne Müllerstochter Lisa und Königssohn Moritz wollen sich, nachdem sie sich zufällig begegnet sind, so bald wie möglich wiedersehen. Doch es kommt anders. Als Müller Gisbert auf dem Schloss damit prahlt, dass seine Tochter Lisa Stroh zu Gold spinnen könne, zwingt ihn der goldgierige König Gustaf, die Müllerstochter zu ihm in den Palast zu schicken.

Der arme Schwarzwälder Köhler Peter Munk bittet zwei geheimnisvolle Waldgeister, sein Schicksal zum Besseren zu wenden. Von einem verschrobenen Glasmännlein darf er sich drei Wünsche erbitten. Doch dem Männlein missfallen Peters erste zwei Wünsche und daraufhin verweigert es ihm den dritten Wunsch. Tatsächlich drohen Peter bald Ruin und Gefängnis. In seiner Not wendet er sich an den zweiten Waldgeist, doch der fordert für seine Hilfe einen hohen Preis.

Im Wald eines Königs treibt ein Naturgeist sein Unwesen, der Eisenhans. Eines Tages gelingt es dem schwarzen Ritter, den Eisenhans zu fangen, und der König lässt ihn in einen Käfig sperren. Doch der junge Prinz Johannes lässt den Eisenhans wieder frei und geht mit ihm in den Wald. Dort lehrt der Eisenhans den jungen Knaben vieles über die Natur und Kräuter. Schließlich schickt der Naturgeist Johannes fort und der junge Prinz macht sich somit auf die Suche nach seinem Glück.

Der junge Bauernjunge Endres findet eine Anstellung als Leibdiener des Königs Konrad. Schnell merkt Endres, dass sein Herr vor aller Welt ein Geheimnis verbirgt: Die goldene Schüssel, die er ihm täglich serviert, enthält eine weiße Schlange. Wer sie isst, kann die Sprache der Tiere verstehen. Skrupellos nutzt Konrad aus, was Maus, Hund oder Adler ihm arglos zutragen. Endres verbündet sich mit der Prinzessin Leonora, um das Geheimnis zu lüften.

Das Märchen vom Salzprinzen erzählt die alte Sage von König Pravoslav, der seine drei Töchter auf eine schwierige Probe stellt. Er will wissen, welche ihn am meisten liebt. Die jüngste Tochter - heimlich verlobt mit dem Salzprinzen, dem Sohn des Königs der Unterwelt - antwortet, sie liebe ihren Vater so sehr wie die Menschen das Salz. Daraufhin verstößt König Pravoslav die jüngste Tochter.

In Zeiten, in denen der Terrorismus allgegenwärtig scheint, muss ein wachsamer Bürger wie Cartman sofort stutzig werden, wenn ein muslimischer Junge nach South Park zieht. Und so beginnt er eine aufwändige Recherche, die zum Ergebnis hat, das offenbar tatsächlich ein Anschlag für den Besuch von Hillary Clinton in South Park geplant ist!

Monica and Chandler are forced to pretend to be a reverend and a doctor when their prospective child's birth mother gets the wrong end of the stick. Meanwhile, Joey's date with Phoebe's friend doesn't go well, and Ross is left with an inappropriate outfit for a date with a sexy salesgirl.
Phoebe and Rachel see Chandler getting into a car with a mystery woman and follow them to a large house in the suburbs. They tell Monica of their fears and are shocked by the truth.
Schwaggins is shocked to discover the truth behind Gerald's trolling, Randy has trouble with the member berries, and Cartman fears Heidi will discover his dubious past.
South Park is in shock at the news Mr Garrison has beaten Hillary Clinton, Cartman gets ever more fearful, and the `Member Berries' unleash their epically nostalgic secret weapon.
The President-elect pays South Park a visit, and he's got revenge on his mind. Cartman gets a pang of jealousy, and the Member Berries fiendish plot continues.
Kyle and Ike rally a panicking South Park to take vengeance on Troll Trace. And Gerald discovers a startling secret at Troll Trace HQ.
Kyle and Cartman team up and gather multiple groups to take down the Internet and Troll Trace. Cartman develops precognitive visions of life on Mars.
Jimmy, GK and Jamali scrutinise controversial behaviour including a case of identity theft, a disagreement over pet goats and an influencer who lies to get out of family parties.
Amy's parents put Robert on the defensive when they point out his strange habit of touching food to his chin before he eats it.
When the MacDougalls are invited to spend Easter with the Barones, the families attempt to bond over a 500-piece jigsaw puzzle.

A young man, Sam Gilula, arrives at Frank and Marie's and everyone is surprised when he and Frank fondly embrace. Sam explains Frank had been quite an inspiration to him as a lad, and Ray and Robert make fun of Frank, wondering how he could have inspired anyone.
Ray and his brother Robert both are feeling very guilty about their actions. This is because they decided to leave their mother Marie alone with work so that they could play golf in peace.
Charlie's influence on Tom disturbs Caroline.
Hungover Caroline recalls Charlie's kiss, but no more.
Joanna wants to attend Caroline's prep school.
Caroline's friend reacts to Charlie's poker buddy.
Caroline's ex-husband wants custody of Tom.
Charlie schemes to thwart Michael's custody attempt.
Hollywood director Colin rejigs a casino robbery scene using demonic possession and `Les Misérables'. Olympian Misty May-Treanor brings the muscle in a World's Strongest Women Competition.

Actress Lydia Greenwood and guest comedian Brad Sherwood join the regulars for a series of hilarious games, including Hollywood Director, Duet, Film Dub, Dubbing, Living Scenery, and Scenes from a Hat.
Criminal calamities including a sleepy burglar, courtroom escapes, and bad getaway drivers.
Featuring insurance scams gone wrong, bear burglars, and some anti-social shenanigans.
Moral-less madness including an indecisive burglar, teddy bear theft, and a naked police chase!
In court, we have man vs elephant, car vs shop, and a cheese slice vs a Ferrari.
Strap yourselves in for some calamitous crime and ludicrous law enforcement.
Moronic misdemeanours including petrol station pillocks, a buffoon on a bridge, and bad bears.
Shining a spotlight on disgruntled shoppers, battles on buses, and a burglar who can't work a door.
Featuring such criminal escapades as delivery drivers gone rogue and some serious monkey business.
Featuring Halloween hooligans, a canine arsonist, and a skirmish over some sun loungers!
Featuring robbers on horseback, goats on trains, and police cars on the run.

Joey appears as a celebrity contestant on 'The $100,000 Pyramid' with its actual host Donny Osmond, but Joey's dubious IQ costs his partner the prize money. Meanwhile, Monica and Rachel hire an ungainly stripper, Roy - without seeing him first - for Phoebe's bachelorette party. Also, Chandler and Ross attend a college reunion and meet an attractive woman they both promised not to date during school.

It's Phoebe and Mike's big day, but all does not go to plan. Wedding planner Monica is driving the bride to distraction, New York is hit by its worst blizzard for 20 years, and Joey is taking his role standing in for Phoebe's incarcerated father far too seriously. Chandler and Ross are upset that neither of them has a role, until Mike needs to replace one of his groomsmen.

Monica and Chandler discover that their prospective adoptive child's biological father may be a 'shovel killer', Ross and Rachel get dangerously close when they go to visit her sick father, and Phoebe struggles to teach Joey French for an audition.

Rachel makes the mistake of going for a job interview at a restaurant where her current boss is also dining. Phoebe discovers she can change her name to whatever she likes - Princess Consuela Bananahammock seems the logical choice, until Mike proves that two can play her game - and Joey, upset that Chandler and Monica are moving, is comforted by an eight-year-old.

When Rachel makes a startling announcement, Ross secretly schemes to get her former job back for her. Meanwhile, Joey is so flustered by all the upheaval in his friends' lives that Phoebe prevents him from learning about the sudden death of his agent. Monica and Chandler make a stunning discovery after they check out the house for sale next door to their new home.

As Rachel prepares to leave for Paris, the gang throw a farewell party for her. Instead of facing them all together, she takes each of them aside for a private goodbye. One friend is offended when he is excluded. Meanwhile, Monica barks out orders as she packs precisely for her life in the suburbs with Chandler, and they watch closely the pregnant mother of their future adopted child.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Joe Wilkinson, Rachel Riley, Chris Ramsey and Tina Malone.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Tess Daly, Stephen Mangan, Kian Egan and Tony Law.
When mysterious power outages strike South America, the townspeople fear Chinese cyberattacks. It's up to the boys to discover what's really going on.
After 237 gigs across 30 countries on his fourth and biggest international tour yet, Russell Howard brings his acclaimed stand-up show to your screens with this special.
Candy and Crystal are joined by comedian Jack Rooke, who is struggling with coming out to his grandma. They also meet Richard, who is struggling with dating having come out later in life.
The Tinder generation in old age.
Van Driessen is badly injured in the woods, and only Beavis and Butt-Head can rescue him. After a wild night out, Middle-aged Beavis wakes up with a tattoo he does not remember getting.
Beavis and Butt-Head use Mr. Anderson's metal detector to find treasure. Middle-aged Butt-Head tries to avoid eviction by getting as fat as possible.
Sara Pascoe, alongside team captains Alan Davies & Darren Harriott, welcomes Jason Manford, Miles Jupp, Henning Wehn and Maisie Adam into the loft to play an array of guessing games.
From working remotely to pitching unconventional business ideas with Steve Byrne, one Joker has a shot at winning a pair of highly sought-after sneakers thanks to NBA star Anthony Davis.
Joined by John Mayer, the Jokers must convince unsuspecting temps to accompany them to a business dinner; the losing Joker has to face the wrath of angry Mayer fans in a humiliating punishment.
The six friends prepare to part ways and set out on the next chapters of their lives, with momentous events and surprises in store.
Phoebe doesn't get on with her identical twin Ursula. Unfortunately, no one can tell them apart, which leads to a few cases of mistaken identity, not least for Joey who is quite taken with Ursula.

Ross comes back from China with his new girlfriend Julie, and Rachel has a really hard time dealing with it. She winds up sleeping with Paolo and hates herself for it. Joey persuades her to tell Ross how she feels, but when Ross tells her he is in love with Julie, she can't bring herself to do it.

While Carol and Susan are away, Ross and the friends babysit his newborn son Ben, but Ross is disgusted when Phoebe tests the temperature of some bottled breast milk on her wrist. Meanwhile, Joey competes with a fellow cologne salesman.
When downstairs neighbour Mr Heckles dies, the friends clean out his flat, but Chandler becomes convinced his hyper-critical nature will mean he ends up alone and sad, just like Heckles.

Everyone is surprised when Phoebe's husband, a gay Canadian ice dancer, shows up, as nobody knew she was married. Elsewhere, Chandler reveals his third nipple, and Ross's new relationship is under attack, unbeknown to him.

Monica gets promoted and invites the friends out for dinner to celebrate, but problems arise when the difference in their salaries becomes apparent and the group splits in two. Meanwhile, when Chandler sets a woman up to get a date with her, a case of mistaken identities means that he discovers what she really thought of him.

Ross agonises over whether he should stay with Julie or date Rachel. The gang encourage him to compare the two, so he starts with a list of Rachel's negative qualities. Unfortunately, Rachel sees the list.
Mr Bean goes back to school where he takes part in a science demonstration, attends an art class and learns the finer points of judo.
Mr Bean goes to the launderette where he loses his trousers once again. He then plays a round of mini golf but has trouble keeping his ball on the green.
Mr Bean has a hard time waiting his turn at the hospital, later he visits Windsor Castle and, that night, has trouble with a bit of insomnia.

Based on the 1980s hit TV series. Brothers Bo and Luke, together with their scantily clad cousin Daisy, cruise around Hazzard County wreaking havoc in their classic Dodge Charger. With the help of their moonshining Uncle Jesse, the two good old boys battle corrupt county commissioner Boss Hogg, when he and the local sheriff threaten to take away the family farm.
Al Murray returns as the hilarious, irreverent and hugely entertaining Pub Landlord.
Live gavel-to-gavel coverage, in-depth legal reporting and expert analysis of America's most important and compelling trials.
Vinnie Politan takes a deep dive into the true-crime stories that are captivating the world over, featuring sharp analysis and insightful interviews for a deeper understanding of these cases.

A registered sex offender's meet with a 13-year-old triggers a dramatic takedown at a busy gas station. Then, Tony's team exposes a grade school janitor's devious plan. Detectives join forces to snare a pastor with unholy fantasies.

Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run. A man wanted for carjacking runs out of road during a high-speed chase; an officer climbs on the hood of a car while trying to prevent a fugitive from fleeing.
911 operators receive a call in the middle of a road rage incident, and state troopers pursue a man wanted for domestic assault and fleeing with his 6-year-old son in the car.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a shopper speaks to police only in rap lyrics, an intruder with an axe asks a woman out on a date, and a university faculty member gets saucy with authorities when she needs to pee.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A woman drives off with a street sign attached to her car, a driver chases a kid on a bike, a woman wakes up one Christmas morning to find a stranger who unwrapped all her gifts.
Over the years, Betty Lou Beets had three failed marriages, each of which ended in their own unique way.
Investigators uncover a web of lies involving a conman, obsessed with reptilian conspiracies, leading to one of the strangest and most chilling murder cases.
Uncover the truth as siblings confront chilling family stories and a disappearance from 1992 reveals its haunting reality.
Uncover a chilling mystery as a man vanishes in 1988, leading police to a shocking serial killer hiding in plain sight.
Step into fear as Pittsburgh detectives hunt a brutal killer whose late night attacks leave the city gripped by terror.
A missing Milwaukee woman's family and community push for answers about her disappearance. What authorities learn a week later sends shockwaves through the city.
Unravel a small town horror as six are killed, one survivor claims no memory and a shocking trial tears an Iowa community apart.
Three brutal cold cases remained unsolved for decades until advances in forensic technology brought investigators closer than ever to finding answers.

Anna Hurd was a troubled teenage girl who thought she had found support and loyalty in Anthony Mitchell. The reality was different. Anthony was a clingy boyfriend who only piled on added family pressure in the run-up to her murder.
The disturbing story of Alan Evans, who tried to get away with murdering his wife by pretending she had fallen down the stairs after she found out about his affair.

Millionaire Peter Morgan moved a young mother, Georgina Symonds, into one of his properties, paying her thousands a month to be his 'girlfriend'. But when the relationship turned sour, he began plotting his revenge.

For years police suspected Levi Bellfield of crimes including sexual assault, GBH and abduction, but there was never enough evidence to charge him. Then they began connecting him with the murders of young blonde women.
Emilia investigates Evie Adams' murder in 2019. The victim's boyfriend, who was already being investigated over two separate deaths, quickly came under suspicion.
Emilia uncovers details surrounding Joshua Stimpson's murder of ex-girlfriend Molly McLaren, a case which shook the victim's family and community to its core.

On 11 May 2006, Nisha Patel-Nasri was upstairs getting ready for bed when she heard the front door open. She grabbed a torch and went to confront the intruder. She was stabbed in the thigh with a John Lewis knife from her kitchen.
In 2013, Simon Hall finally admitted to the brutal murder of Joan Albert that had occurred over a decade earlier. Former senior detective Graham Hill investigates.

When a young goth couple, Rob Maltby and Sophie Lancaster, are set upon by a 'pack of feral thugs', the vicious attack leaves eyewitnesses afraid to speak up. Despite the very public attack, a wall of silence falls around the offenders.

A father-son trip ends in horror when 51-year-old Lee Pomeroy is the victim of a savage knife attack on a commuter train. Lee is stabbed 18 times in 25 seconds and dies in the arms of his 14-year-old son before help can arrive.

When an ambitious Luxor dancer on the eve of her biggest night misses rehearsal and disappears, Metro detectives investigate an abandoned car, security video and backstage trysts until a grisly discovery stuns the Strip's close-knit dance community.

After a larger-than-life bookie vanishes without a trace, Metro detectives delve into the world of mobsters, informants and greed until two bodies in the Mojave Desert and a motorway traffic stop reveal a plot of murderous betrayal.

Metro detectives hunt for clues in grainy surveillance video after a rising rapper is gunned down outside a Las Vegas hot spot, leaving his anguished family seeking answers. A similar attack reveals a cold-blooded pattern and callous murderer.
A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A woman bites an officer, slips her handcuffs and takes off in a police car. And a man urinates on $10,000 worth of canned meat.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A shopper on gummies freaks out at the supermarket, a man drives backwards on a major thoroughfare, and a car smashes through a fast-food restaurant.
A peaceful Sunday morning ends in tragedy when a car accident ends in a deadly altercation. A 25-year-old man is charged with second-degree murder after he shoots a teenage driver dead.

A series of disappearances ends with the kidnapping of Bernice Worden in broad daylight. When suspicion falls on quiet foreman Ed Gein, the police begin an investigation that will lead to the most shocking discoveries in the history of crime.

Two masked gunmen commit a violent robbery and shoot Michael Temple Jr., rendering him a quadriplegic for five years before his death; in this unusual cold case, DNA from a knife is used to create a sketch of the killer.

When the body of 81-year-old Helen Gale is found in her burned-out car, investigators in Southfield, Michigan wonder who would murder this pillar of the community. It will be eight years before a blown alibi brings them face-to face with her killer.
Focusing on a different location each week in the modern State of Israel and showing its relevance as a tourist site while highlighting its significance in the Bible.
'Healing Miracles' showcases the healing power of Jesus Christ with Addison Adamu by exploring various healing testimonies and miracles from people of all walks of life.

The Christian Worship Hour with Dr Harold E. Salem proclaims the Word of God simply and humbly in all its truth and purity, with special concern and compassion for the lost and with hope and encouragement for all believers.
Tim Timberlake brings a message of hope and inspiration that will build faith and trust in God. He goes directly to God's Word to provide solutions to some of life's toughest problems.
The worldwide ministry of Rod Parsley and his work to revive the life of God in human hearts.
Join Pastors Larry and Tiz Huch from Dallas, Texas as they share revelations from the Word of God.
Messianic rabbi KA Schneider looks at how the Old and New Testaments are integrated, building faith and changing lives.

A Christmas story that carries a year-round message. A spoiled schoolgirl, her overworked executive mother and a disillusioned minister are encouraged by a friendly, but mysterious drifter named Jess.
Renowned Christian scholar Rick Renner delves into the Greek New Testament, blending historical texts with modern illustrations to unpack God's message for His believers.

Featuring in-depth interviews, as host Gary Stearman talks with expert writers, teachers and pastors. Discussions range across the spectrum of Bible prophecy as seen through both history and current events.
Dr Charles Stanley, pastor of the First Baptist Church in Atlanta, shares his insights on Christian faith and enlightens viewers with spiritual motivation.
Minister Rick Pearson discusses the hidden mysteries of America's role in Bible prophecy.
Perry Stone delivers a practical message in order to reach the lost, to teach the Word, and to show the anointing of the Holy Spirit through evangelism and worship.
Familiar hymns and beautifully produced original music accompany Scripture to help you let go and surrender during a time of daily prayer and meditation.
Rabbi Jonathan Bernis of Jewish Voice Ministries shares the lessons he learned after his miraculous health recovery.
Equipping Pastors, group leaders and church members with biblical truth and tools to heal themselves and take healing to a wounded world.
Pastor Ron Carpenter of Redemption Bay Area in San Jose, California presents Bible-based teachings, teaching truth and knowledge through a kingdom perspective.
An impactful prophetic program that will edify and propel you forward, and upwards in your spiritual life.

Chris Mitchell reports from one of the most explosive regions in the world. Offers a biblical and prophetic perspective to the daily news events that shape our world, with a particular focus on Israel and the Middle East.
Israel Now News is a weekly TV news magazine. It presents a unique perspective of Israel's current events, politics, and culture to an English-speaking audience.

Dr. Creflo Dollar ministers to all walks of life with hope for change. With a renewal of faith, mind, and spirit, he and his wife Taffi share their vision for all to understand God's love and promises.
The teaching ministry of American Southern Baptist pastor and television host Dr Robert Jeffress. He is a Senior Minister of the First Baptist Church in Dallas as well as a Fox News contributor.
Free Chapel pastor, Jentezen Franklin, shares his interpretation of the Bible by bringing practical meaning to spiritual truths in a contemporary world.
Pastors John and Matt Hagee of Hagee Ministries in San Antonio, TX, deliver messages from God's Word, proclaiming the bold truth of His promises.
Pastor Allen Jackson brings a Biblical perspective to the ever-changing world, encouraging believers to lead with their faith in every arena - no matter what shaking the season may bring.
Messages from author and evangelist Joel Osteen as he preaches of love and hope. The pastor urges people to live to their full potential and form a close relationship with God.

Dr Michael Youssef speaks about the Word of God or the Gospel in order to help people who have lost faith in God and assist them to tread the path of righteousness by following the teachings of Jesus.
Pastor Travis Johnson, travels around the world and builds a strong network while ministering through different churches.
A biblical and prophetic exploration of Israel, past, present and future. Hosted by Dr. John Tweedie and filmed entirely on location in Israel.
A spiritual ministry dealing with such issues as health, family values and spiritual principles.
A church service including praise and worship and an inspiring message by Pastor Mac Hammond.
Les loses his temper when the kids suggest he sells their failing second store. With the family's livelihood at stake, Seth puts a sneaky plan into action.
Ashley is pulled into the fray as Seth's plan to sell the Pontiac shop hits a snag. Then a meeting with a buyer leaves them in a life-changing situation.
The Golds acquire a potentially rare guitar but struggle to determine its authenticity. Meanwhile, Ashley finds herself at loggerheads with a challenging customer.
Something's rotten in the yard, and it threatens to spoil everything. Jason has the inside track on a container that could have him coasting to paradise.
A dream container from Jaipur, India, threatens Mo and Ty's partnership. Can they work through their differences with some hidden gems?
The Israelis form an unexpected alliance that threatens to bury their competition; John digs up a container from beyond the grave.
An entire container with a suspicious past excites Mo and Ty. But nothing is what it seems! And, the Israelis take a gamble on some big beach gear.

Burton-on-Trent in Staffordshire plays host to David Dickinson and his team. Some glamorous calendar girls turn up on Alison Chapman's table, and one of Tim Hogarth's favourite type of items turns up.

Oswestry is the location for David Dickinson and his team as David Ford has his work cut out with a young man who has brought in a set of gold sovereigns and Brenda Haller tries her best to buy a Bakelite telephone.

Dealers Michael Hogben, Brenda Haller, David Tupman and Simon Schneider are in Stoke-on-Trent. Amongst the items of interest are an Asprey's silver chamberstick, a 1950s Wilson pram and a quirky gaming dice.

While exploring the historic silver mining town of Cobalt, the salvage team uncovers some exciting hidden treasures inside an old Nash car dealership, including a massive 1915 Woolworth's sign and vintage jukeboxes.
Under the watchful eye of Uncle Ryan, Julien puts his operator skills to the test during a delicate and risky demolition job.
Vic goes on a road trip to salvage a pair of vintage gas pumps to add to his personal collection.
As the Priestlys look to the future, Ted's salvage team is tasked with clearing out The National with a huge one-day sale.
Ted and Justin travel to Market Village Mall in Markham, Ontario, where they are tasked with carefully unlocking mysterious vault doors while the demolition team begins tear down.

At the site of the former Yugoslavian Consulate, Ted hopes to salvage invaluable secret relics of the Cold War. Back at the National, a buyer shows interest in a vintage WW II truck, but Ted has to convince him the price is right.

The Clermont Diggers face pressure to repay $15,000 worth of gold or risk losing their mine. Gold Snipers Rob and Levi battle the Tasmanian wilderness to access a secret river system. And the Mineshaft Hunters enter an abandoned gold mine.
Businessman and rookie miner Dennis gambles $500,000 on a 6-acre gold mine, while Leigh asks two British backpackers for a lesson in metal detecting.
Gold mining expert Ian Holland takes on 25-year-old rookie prospector April as an apprentice, while rookie miner Dennis tries to get started with the gold processing plant.
Donnie confronts poachers who seem to be taking gold from his property, while Dennis and his team initiate an unexpected raid.
The Clermont Diggers come up with a new plan to try and boost their daily gold output, but the radical strategy has deep flaws.
It's D-Day for the Clermont Diggers. They have 48 hours to repay investor Dennis, but suddenly Leigh goes missing.
It is D-Day for the Clermont Diggers, they have just 48 hours to repay investor Dennis. Meanwhile, Rob's gold haul is washed down the river.
A catastrophic breakdown threatens to end the Clermont Diggers' mining season, while the rookie miners' gamble to relocate their old plant ends in disaster.
It's panic stations for the Clermont Diggers when a tourist goes missing. Meanwhile, prospector April is in the line of fire in Ballarat.
Another breakdown triggers all out war between the Clermont Diggers and the Rookie Miners, while a storm causes havoc for Gold Sniper and Rob.
Rookie miner Dennis enjoys a personal-best nugget find in a bumper day, while the Mineshaft Hunters' quest for gold is cut short when a team member takes a life-threatening fall.
The Rookie Miner's search for a mythical gold reef backfires badly, but in Ballarat, prospector Ian and his apprentice April finish their season with a $19,000 gold bonanza.
As the season comes to a close, the Clermont Diggers unearth a monster nugget. Meanwhile, the Mineshaft Hunters face a life-or-death emergency.

Live feed from Mecca every day that would enlighten our viewers by bringing visuals live from Islam's Holiest.
Melodious recitation of the Holy Qur'an with English translation.

Lecture by Sh. Ahmad Saad on changing within yourself.

A novice builder attempts to construct a cabin in Vermont's White River Valley. The harsh winter and his lack of experience make this a challenging build.

The Raneys attempt to save a single mother and her daughter from a rampant moose, Marty builds a bridge across a creek and Matt teaches predator deterrent techniques.
The Raneys head off to answer an SOS call from an off-grid couple, but with severe storms threatening floods, they are in a race against time.
The Raneys try to restore a failed homestead in Ohio. Marty's only hope is an old gas well, which if he can get working, can breathe life back into the property.
The crew rebuilds the Minor Hill cabin in Franklin, Tenn.; Mark Bowe checks out a log cabin addition to an 1806 stone home and tours a local whiskey distillery built inside a timber-frame barn.
A man claims that he had been to Denmark to buy a duck. Stefan stops him at Sweden's border and does not find any duck among the alcohol he has brought with him. A man at Arlanda is enraged.

New discoveries found under the tomb of Jesus Christ are investigated. Plus, innovative technology is used to decode faded manuscripts.

Henry and Fuzz visit Martin in Ipswich. Henry has his eye on a vintage Land Rover and Fuzz finds a miniature scooter.
Henry and Fuzz explore Roger's garage of buses in Coventry. For former mechanic Fuzz, it's a busman's holiday, for Henry, it's a voyage of discovery.
Henry and Fuzz meet a lifelong biker with unique motorbikes. Fuzz discovers a 1950s step-through scooter, but Henry prefers low-capacity sports bikes.
Henry and stand-in searcher Guy are in Wiltshire visiting collectors Adam and Dan who have an assortment of trucks, tractors, and rare American cars.

A series of violent explosions rips through a major Texas oil refinery, causing a fatal disaster and devastation on a terrifying scale; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover what triggered a catastrophic malfunction.

Tragedy strikes a bustling Canadian shopping mall when a parking garage suddenly collapses resulting in a fatal disaster; expert engineers use the latest technology to investigate and uncover a deadly design flaw that could have been prevented.

Construction turns catastrophic in New Orleans when the side of a hotel complex collapses on a busy street below; expert engineers investigate to uncover the reason behind this sudden and fatal disaster.
Bruce Crompton and his team embark on a tour across Europe to buy and restore some of WW2's rarest tanks. Later, he shows off his famous Sherman in a home-movie re-enactment.
Bruce and the team hunt down the rarest and most inventive spy gear used during WWII, from a rare Enigma machine in Italy to a special pencil in the UK.
The team look for the most impressive and advanced uniforms of WW2, exploring the vital role of clothing and kit in gaining an advantage against the enemy.

Henry Cole's chosen dream machine for home tarmac is a Norton 961 Café Racer. Setting out from the most northerly tip of the UK, John O'Groats, Henry plots a meandering route southwards in an attempt to experience the best roads on offer.

Henry Cole samples some of the most scenic parts of the UK with stop offs in The Lake District, The Pennines and The Cotswolds. He completes his ride at Land's End in Cornwall with some scones and ice cream.
Henry Cole takes his Metisse Steve McQueen Desert Racer on a 1500-mile ride of a lifetime from Ljubljana, Slovenia, to Sofia, Bulgaria, taking in Croatia, Bosnia and Serbia along the way.
The lost city of Olous: A great metropolis submerged in the Mediterranean; archaeologists uncover its secrets using pioneering technology and CGI reconstruction.

The Pantheon is a 2,000-year-old temple with a secret; using cutting-edge archaeological methods and brand-new evidence, experts look beneath the streets of Rome to find out why it was built and how it survived so long.

According to legend, the ancient Roman city of Hierapolis hides a secret portal to the underworld beneath its streets; armed with pioneering technology, archaeologists gain rare access to investigate the deadly truth behind these hellish myths.
Automata artisans, Michael and Maria restore an acrobatic figurine from France. Meanwhile, sculptor, Nick manages to revive a pair of motorbikes previously used on fairground rides.
The force is strong with paper conservator, Ashleigh, as she takes on the challenge of restoring an original Star Wars poster. Upholsterer, Ray, updates a pair of designer chairs from the 1960s.
Painter, Gill brings the romance back to an old and faded Chinese marriage cabinet. Later, leather specialist, Martin finds and saves a rare suitcase that's one of the best he's seen.

Experts explore the legend of the Wendigo, a zombie-like creature doomed in Native American folklore to forever walk alone with its cannibalistic cravings. A new theory suggests this entity may come from somewhere not of this Earth.
Experts investigate shocking new DNA evidence that links one of the world's most elusive figures, the Yeti, resides in America and comes from an otherworldly source.
Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot embark on a mission to find out what's happening on the Island of the Dolls, a dangerous place that locals have long avoided.
Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres dive into the legend of Mothman by searching for clues in a long-sealed bunker and a top-secret Air Force base.
In Cremona, how do they make modern violins that sound as good as the legendary Stradivarius? And, how do they build houses with volcanic rock?
How does a Dutch company make the world's fastest superyachts? And, how do they make a new space suit that weighs and costs a fifth of the previous design?
How do planes take off and land on a beach at one of the world's oldest airports? Plus, how do they hand-make the national dress of Bavaria, lederhosen?
How do they catch the world's largest lobsters, and how do they build the iconic chesterfield sofa? Plus, how do they capture the world's sharpest TV pictures?

For four years, the Messenger space probe sent images of Mercury, the solar system's smallest planet, closest to the Sun. It has revealed that Mercury has a dangerous secret that may one day threaten life on Earth.

The solar system is different to others in the Milky Way, but it hides a violent past. Scientists examine the clues to reveal its secret history and new discoveries reveal that the Earth and planets were formed from the destruction of strange worlds.
More everyday items go under the microscope. How are objects including bamboo ceramic lights and asphalt compactors made?
More everyday items go under the microscope. How are objects including asphalt pavers, and Basque espadrilles made?
The host explores and explains the proper making of leather basketballs, wood panel canvases, shoelaces and floodgates in large quantities for public use.
What are the production processes behind common objects including Asian bowl meals and walking canes?
How do they produce almost all of America's raisins in California's San Joaquin Valley? Plus, how do they make the world's oldest type of paper?
How do they use ancient techniques and modern technology to produce thousands of tonnes of barbecue charcoal? Plus, how do they cook up Japan's soba noodles?
How do they grow America's only freshwater pearls in Tennessee? Plus, how are the world's sharpest knives made, and how do they forge these knives?
How do they turn ugly root vegetables into sweet sugar, and how do they make feather dusters? Plus, how do they make billions of balloons to keep parties popping?
Adam and a demolition expert stage a series of daring experiments on one of the world's most dangerous and explosive substances: Nitroglycerin.

Adam teams up with actor Gary Oldman to build one of Hollywood's deadliest weapons: the ZF1 multi-artillery gun from sci-fi film, The Fifth Element. It is weapon so lethal that it features both a rocket launcher and a flamethrower.
Black holes are not the violent monsters people think they are, and new discoveries reveal that they might have been essential to creating stars, giving light and building the universe itself.
Nebulas are the strange structures of cosmic gas and dust where stars are born and die. New discoveries reveal the secrets of these mysterious places.
Examines how metal nail files, birchbark canoes, cruiser boat hardtops, and high-voltage circuit breakers are made.
Examines how manufactured and homemade items such as macarons, pine needle baskets, and micrometres are made.
An examination of the ins and outs of the manufacturing processes for endoscopes, megaphones, and uranium.
Examines the various processes which are used to make items such as hollow disk pumps, palm sugar, and yachts.

Josh explores three locations where stone labyrinths hide something incredible, including a vast city carved deep into a canyon in the Jordanian desert, and a dark South Pacific cave once used as a kitchen by a cannibal tribe.

Josh explores other great walls around the world, from a cursed fortress along India's Aravalli Mountains, to a series of towering metal forks that once defended Britain from the Nazis and were taken over by pirate radio stations.

Josh explores places where unusual heroes rule the day, from a legendary pirate paradise near Madagascar to a small Mexican town that celebrates a wealthy rancher's generosity with the most explosive festival on Earth.
Josh shines a light on places darkened by the past, from a mysterious mansion connected to a haunted heiress in California to a colourful festival commemorating the death of a demon in India.
The lawless territory of Montana is up for grabs, so William Clark and Marcus Daly fight to control power over the state and to mine millions in copper ore.
With 300 inventions, Nikola Tesla's work still dominates the world today. Interviews with experts reveal the fascinating life of the great inventor.
A witness claims to have discovered a long-lost ship. Experts launch an investigation to try and positively identify the missing vessel.
Richard's new state-of-the-art workshop is finally open but with nearly a quarter of a million out of his pocket, the business has got to start paying for itself.
The team test two electric vans, the Ford E-Transit and the Fiat e-Ducato, which both claim to top 150 miles between recharges, but it remains to be seen if they live up to the billing.
Trying out some larger vehicles, the team test a plug-in Hybrid VW T7 Transporter and match it up against a 7-seat PHEV SUV costing the same amount of money, the Hyundai Santa Fe.
JDV and Sid tackle some challenging terrain in a Land Rover P400E Defender. Vicki tries out the new MG EV4 and in Italy, Grace drives Ferrari's first V6, the 296 GTS hybrid.
Lockheed were tasked with creating a plane invisible to Russian radar, capable of reaching an altitude of 80,000 ft and speeds of Mach 3.2.
Emerging as a rival to Boeing's 247, the rigorously tested twin-engine DC-3 would eventually radicalise the aviation industry in 1934.
This double-decked monster was designed to carry 800 passengers and revolutionise the highways of the sky, so why did it take 17 years to lift off?

Henry and Sam are rummaging again. They meet Phil in sunny Buckinghamshire, where they find stationary engines, traction engines and vintage petrol cans, but is there anything for the boys to restore and flog?

Henry and his ace mechanic mate Sam Lovegrove are in Surrey where they find Pontiac ambulances, mysterious automotive sculptures, and strangely well-preserved motorbikes. Later, in Cornwall, they meet a collector whose cottage is like a transport museum, chock-full with memorabilia, penny farthings and lights of all description.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace mechanic Sam Lovegrove are off to Cornwall. They meet a collector whose cottage is like a transport museum, chock-full with memorabilia, penny farthings and lights of all description.

The boys are off to the West Country and Oxfordshire, in search of vintage treasure to buy, restore and flog. Their discoveries include rare motoring memorabilia, 1970s kitsch and a fabulous collection of stationary engines.
In Barcelona, Mike and Elvis try to restore a SEAT 600, but an unexpected breakdown and some nasty bills put the boys' profit margin in peril.
Mike and Elvis travel to Turkey in search of one of the rarest cars they've ever bought, the Anadol STC16, but the one they find needs major work.
Mike and Elvis try to give a rare Škoda 110R a rally inspired makeover, but they soon discover it's a bigger and more expensive job than they thought.

Mike and Elvis travel to Turin and set about trying to rescue a rundown Fiat Barchetta. But when parts prove almost impossible to find, it looks like they may have to say arrivederci to their Italian sports car dream.

Having wanted to buy a Ford Cortina for 20 years, Mike finally finds a rust-free Mk2 in Malta. Unfortunately, the rest of the car is a complete shambles so it's down to Elvis and some plucky Maltese mechanics to try and rescue Mike's Cortina dream.
In Devon, presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove are on a mission to buy automobilia for a client's man cave. The guys uncover a 1937 petrol pump and a pricey tyre inflator.

This time, the duo fondly recall Rodney's rusty lair packed full of signs, petrol pumps and vintage British cars. Rodney found it hard to part with some of the items the deal-searching duo wanted, but they eventually came away with even more.
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove rescue interesting items from a scrapyard in Devon. The guys find some classic vehicles, including a neglected Jaguar Mark 1.
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove visit an incredible collection of Ford vehicles in Worcestershire. But the guys have their sights set on a 1960s Austin A40 Farina.
Mike ends up having a tip from an unusual source, from his electrician. He's selling a classic Ford Escort XR3i that he's owned for decades, but there are some issues with the roof.
Mike lands a desirable three-door Mk1 for £4500 in an internet auction. Will Edd's customisations and improvements bring a new lease of life to this much-loved 70s classic?
Mike Brewer makes a return to the United Kingdom with Marc Elvis Priestley and find iconic cars to revive them before selling.

Mike buys a 1995 Ford Escort RS Cosworth, a rare vehicle originally designed to qualify as a car for the World Rally Championship. Ant attempts to bring back the 227 hp engine's famous 'fizz' and adds a special detail.
Mike is after a Ford Sierra Cosworth, which looks like a family vehicle and runs like a race car, but with only £5,000 to spend, is his plan about to stall?
In an attempt to win work, Richard Hammond and the team decide to enter one of their cars into the UK's most prestigious classic car show contest, known as the 'Concours of Elegance'.

Verkleidet als Charaktere von Clash of Swords schleichen sich Mitch und Phil zur Hero-Con. Dort tritt Phil jedoch in ein fatales Fettnäpfchen. Unterdessen wird Glorias Dinosaurierfeier für Joe von ihrer Erzfeindin und Nachbarin übertroffen.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.

Die Sendung bringt mit vielen neuen Ideen frischen Wind auf die Bildschirme. Schneiden, Kleben, Ausmalen und Mitgestalten - sie zeigt großen und kleinen Zuschauern, wie man aus den unscheinbarsten Dingen die tollsten Sachen zaubert.

Sparks stellt sich seiner Angst, um ZsaZsa davon abzuhalten, die Bootsfahrt zu ruinieren.
Onkel Rad und Frisky tauchen auf und müssen für Bluey und Bingo Babysitter sein.

Bluey und Bingo spielen "Das Schweigespiel" und wollen Dad sagen, welches Spielzeug er für sie kaufen soll. Am Ende seiner Kräfte spannt Dad den neuen Verkäufer Alfie in das Spiel ein, um die Pantomime zu interpretieren.

Im Park trifft Bluey auf eine neue Kameradin namens Winnie. Als Bluey sie jedoch mit ihrem Vater zum Frühstück einladen möchte, stellt sie fest, dass Erwachsene etwas länger brauchen, bis sie neue Freunde gefunden haben.

Bluey und ihr Vater freuen sich auf das Schwimmbad. Sie packen ihre Sachen. Ihre Mutter braucht viel länger, weil sie nichts vergessen will. Zunächst machen Bluey und ihr Vater sich darüber lustig. Dann stellen sie fest, dass das auch Vorteile hat.

Kaufmannsladen ist das Lieblingsspiel von Bluey und ihren Freunden. Aber Bluey hinterfragt ständig die Regeln und ändert, wer welche Rolle übernimmt. Wenn sie sich nicht bald einigen, dauert es noch ewig, bis das Spiel beginnen kann.

Bluey hat einen eigenen Taxiservice und schon ihren ersten Fahrgast: ihren Vater. Der ist Geschäftsmann und muss ganz dringend zum Flughafen. Doch leider hat Bluey nicht mit allen Verzögerungen gerechnet und nun könnte Papa seinen Flug verpassen.

Mama geht alleine am Strand spazieren, doch Bluey möchte ihr eine Muschel zeigen und rennt ihr hinterher. Zum ersten Mal ist sie alleine unterwegs und folgt Mamas Fußspuren. Dabei macht Bluey einige spannende Begegnungen.

Bingo und Bluey spielen Oma, doch als Bingo den Floss-Dance tanzt, besteht Bluey darauf, dass Omas den Tanz nicht tanzen können. Uneinig darüber, wer recht hat, rufen sie ihre eigene Oma an, um eine Antwort auf ihre Frage zu bekommen.
Bluey und Bingo verbringen zusammen mit ihren Cousins den Tag bei ihrer Oma. Sie wollen spielen.
Bingo muss zu Hause ohne ihre Schwester spielen, und sie hat Schwierigkeiten, damit anzufangen.
Papa ist an der Reihe, den Kindern Frühstück mitzugeben und sie an der Schule abzusetzen, aber Bluey und Bingo werden es ihm nicht leicht machen, pünktlich dort zu sein.
Als Mama die Bingobettgeschichten zu Ende liest, verspricht Bingo, dass sie in ihrem Bett aufwacht.
Bluey und Bingo leben auf einer einsamen Insel und entdecken ihren Papa am Strand.
Die Friseure Bluey und Bingo entdecken, dass ihr Kunde Bert Hübschmann Nissen hat!
Bluey und Bingo gehen erst zu ihrer Spielstunde mit Judo, wenn die Gummiechse von der Decke fällt.
Bingo ist eine vorbildliche Bürgerin. Bluey hingegen interessiert sich nur dafür, Spaß zu haben.
Bingo und Bluey wechseln sich damit ab, die Königin und ihr treuer Diener zu sein.
Bluey und Bingo benutzen Verpackungen und Luftpolsterfolie, um ihre eigene Zivilisation zu bauen.
Shadow Moth erschafft einen Superschurken, als Marinette und Adrien sich nicht verwandeln können.

Der Bösewicht Shadow Moth erschafft ein furchterregendes Sentimonster namens Sentibubbler, um Rena Rouge unter Druck zu setzen. Das Monster wird erst aufhören, wenn Rena dazu bereit ist, Ladybug und Cat Noir zu verraten.

Cricket und Gloria werden beauftragt, einen der letzten Kaffeesäcke zu beschaffen. Dieser befindet sich jedoch im Besitz von Chip Whistler, der nicht leicht mit sich verhandeln lässt; Crickets Familie sucht nach dem verschwundenen Hund Phoenix.
Frisch aus dem Gefängnis entlassen, sorgt Crickets und Tillys Mutter für jede Menge Unruhe.
Bluey will, dass Dad ihr beim Zeichnen eines Drachens für ihre Geschichte hilft.

Bingo und Lila wollen auf ihrer neuen Wasserrutsche spielen, doch diese ist voller Käfer.
Die Väter kämpfen bei einem freundschaftlichen Kricketspiel in der Nachbarschaft um den Sieg.
Papa gibt vor, ein Makler zu sein, der Omas Haus an Mama verkauft. Oma will aber nicht ausziehen.
Bluey und Bingo möchten, dass Papa zwei verschiedene Spiele spielt, also versucht es Papa.

Ein Kleinkind wird in Gigantitan akumatisiert. Das Riesenbaby sucht in ganz Paris nach einem Lutscher und zerstört alles, was sich ihm in den Weg stellt. Es wird wohl kein Kinderspiel für Ladybug und Cat Noir, den riesigen Kleinen aufzuhalten.

Mulans alter, kranker Vater soll in die Armee eingezogen werden, um die einfallenden Mongolen zu bekämpfen. Da er in seinem Zustand die Strapazen des Krieges nicht überleben würde, verkleidet sich die junge Mulan als Mann und gibt sich als ihr Vater aus. Ihre Vorfahren sind mit diesem Plan nicht einverstanden und schicken deshalb den kleinen Drachen Mushu hinterher, um sie von ihrem Vorhaben abzubringen. Doch als er Mulan begegnet, schlägt er sich auf ihre Seite.

Percy, Annabeth und Grover durchstreifen die Unterwelt und suchen nach dem gestohlenen Herrscherblitz. Infolgedessen sieht sich die Gruppe dazu gezwungen, zu ihrer eigenen Sicherheit mit dem Gott der Unterwelt zu verhandeln.

Percy kämpft auf der Spitze des Empire State Building verbissen gegen Zeus. Doch Poseidons Eingreifen bringt eine überraschende Wendung mit sich. Luke versucht derweil, Percy zu beeinflussen, während Annabeth auftaucht und einen Dieb verjagt.

Familie Taylor bereitet eine Überraschungsparty für Wilson vor, zu der alle Freunde eingeladen sind. Als Überraschungsgast haben sie seine Nichte Willow eingeladen, die in einem 53er-Studebaker vorfahren soll. Das Auto hat früher seinem Vater gehört.

Jill lernt den attraktiven Ian kennen, der sie um ein Date bittet. Als sie ihm erzählt, dass Tim ihr Ehemann ist, ist Ian überrascht, da er dachte, dass sie Geschwister seien. Schockiert stellt Jill fest, dass die Leidenschaft in ihrer Ehe fehlt.

Al erfährt, dass seine Ex wieder heiraten will und ist vollkommen deprimiert. Tim versucht ihn aufzumuntern und gibt ihm den Rat, mehr zu unternehmen. Daraufhin verbringt Al nahezu jeden Abend bei den Taylors.

Brad bekommt ein Fußball-Stipendium von einer Uni in North Carolina angeboten. Tim ist so stolz auf seinen Sohn, dass er sich sofort als sein Coach bereit erklärt. Um das Selbstbewusstsein zu steigern, sagt Tim ihm täglich, wie toll er ist.

Randy will für die Schulzeitung einen Bericht über umweltbewusste Firmen schreiben. Tim verspricht ihm, ein Interview mit seinem Chef von Binford zu organisieren. Doch wie Randy herausfindet, zählt er zu einem der schlimmsten Umweltsünder der Stadt.

Familie Taylor freut sich auf den gemeinsamen Familien-Urlaub mit geheimem Ziel. Jill ist damit beschäftigt, die Koffer zu packen, während Brad noch unter der Trennung von Angela leidet. Als Tim dann bekannt gibt, wohin es geht, sind alle sprachlos.

Jill wünscht sich ein eigenes Büro im Dachgeschoss, um ungestört arbeiten zu können. Darauf hat Tim nur gewartet und stürzt sich bereits in die Arbeit. Jills Bitte, den Ausbau schlicht zu halten, werden von Tim überhört.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.

Tony Sallis und sein Team haben bei einer Hausdurchsuchung mehrere mutmaßliche Straftäter aus dem Drogenmilieu im Visier. Die Verdächtigen sind wahrscheinlich bewaffnet, deshalb müssen die Gesetzeshüter sehr vorsichtig vorgehen.
Tanya Watkins und Harrison Beverley fahren mit ihrem zivilen Dienstwagen in Northamptonshire zur M1. Dort haben Überwachungskameras das Kennzeichen einer aktenkundigen Alkoholsünderin erfasst.

In einer Mainzer Einkaufsstraße tritt ein Gas aus und es herrscht Explosionsgefahr. Als die Einsatzkräfte die Ursache ausfindig machen, staunen sie nicht schlecht, denn es handelt sich nicht einfach um ein simples Gasleck.

In Dresden steckt ein kleines Kind zwischen zwei Holzbalken fest und braucht dringend die Hilfe der Feuerwehr. Um den Dreijährigen aus seiner misslichen Lage zu befreien, ist diesmal ein wahres Improvisationstalent gefragt.

Im Hafen von Barcelona kontrollieren die Zöllner Lkw-Anhänger, die mit der Fähre nach Tanger übersetzen. Es dauert nicht lange, bis die Beamten einen manipulierten Sattelauflieger entdecken. Außerdem gerät ein Fluggast aus Vancouver in Erklärungsnot.

Ein Spezialauftrag führt Thorsten Eckert in dieser Folge nach Frankfurt am Main. Der Asphalt Cowboy soll dort im Stadtwald Baumstämme abholen. Aber dann streikt am Lastkraftwagen plötzlich die Lenkung und ohne diese Maschine ist er aufgeschmissen.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Josh hilft, den reichsten verlorenen Schatz Amerikas zu bergen. Mit modernster Technologie und einer Flotte von Booten taucht das Team in der Karibik, um Münzen und Juwelen der legendären spanischen Galeone Maravillas an die Oberfläche zu bringen.

Bei extremer Hitze begeben sich Adam, Heather und Sam auf einen 15 Kilometer langen Marsch zu einem großen Fluss. Lindsay, Terra und Nathan kämpfen sich währenddessen durch ein von Schlangen besiedeltes Grasfeld zu einem Bach vor.
Die Küste von Zululand am Indischen Ozean ist der Schauplatz für den Showdown der Survival-Challenge.

Ed kämpft sich durch die Region Kimberley im Nordwesten Australiens. In dieser Gegend wimmelt es nur vor Giftschlangen und Riesenkrokodilen. Die Hitze dort ist extrem. Ed versucht, sich vor der Sonne zu schützen. Zudem findet er Austern als Nahrung.

Im Okavangodelta lauern unzählige Gefahren. Die Region im Nordwesten Botswanas ist mit über 20 000 Quadratkilometern eines der größten Feuchtgebiete Afrikas. Dort leben viele Raubtiere, wie zum Beispiel Leoparden, Hyänen und Wildhunde. Außerdem hat Ed Stafford dort mit der stacheligen Vegetation zu kämpfen. Die Dornen machen dem Briten auf dem schwarzen Kontinent so sehr zu schaffen, dass er sich Schuhe aus Palmwedeln bastelt.
Team Salvage schließt sich mit dem Hafenmeister zusammen, um die Wasserstraße freizumachen.

Luke Purdy und seine Crew nehmen im nördlichen Gebiet eine 14 Meter lange Jacht an den Haken. Der Auftrag bringt den Abschlepp-Profis 25 000 Dollar ein. Aber dieses Geld muss sich die Truppe in Down Under hart erarbeiten.

Die Grenzpolizei überprüft in der schwedischen Hauptstadt drei Personen ohne Gepäck, denn der Stockholmer Flughafen ist ein Sicherheitsbereich. Dort darf man sich nur aus einem berechtigten Grund aufhalten.

Am Stockholmer Flughafen ist eine Maschine aus Istanbul gelandet. An Bord befindet sich eine gesuchte Person. Der Passagier hat gegen Bewährungsauflagen verstoßen. Er wurde wegen Drogendelikten verurteilt.

Rick Ness hat eine Million Dollar investiert, um auf dem Walhalla-Abschnitt bis zum Gold vorzudringen. Aber nach mehr als vier Wochen Arbeit stößt sein Team stattdessen auf eine siebeneinhalb Meter dicke Lehmschicht. Wurde zu hoch gepokert?

Parker Schnabel versucht, verlorene Zeit wettzumachen. Der Minenboss kauft für eine Million Dollar eine neue Waschanlage. Die Golden Goose verfügt über längere Waschrinnen und ein modifiziertes Siebdeck, was einen höheren Durchsatz ermöglicht. Damit kann sein Team am Dominion River schneller und effizienter arbeiten. Doch zunächst müssen die Goldgräber das 40-Tonnen-schwere Monstrum einsatzbereit machen. Auch Tony Beets stürzt sich in Kosten.

Andreas, Tobi und Andrew suchen in Australien nach einem Edelmetallvorkommen. Doch dann bricht wegen der Trockenheit ein Feuer aus. Dieses darf sich nicht ausbreiten, da ein Flächenbrand die umliegenden Farmen und die Wildtiere bedrohen würde.

Die Macherey haben in Australien hart gearbeitet. Es naht in Down Under die Stunde der Wahrheit. Welche Empfehlung spricht Andreas im Northern Territory aus? Wird sich die Schatzsuche dort auszahlen? Mark vertraut auf Andreas' Einschätzung.

Im fiktiven Derry lauert in den Abwasserkanälen etwas Uraltes und Böses. Es nährt sich von den Ängsten der Kinder. Haben Ereignisse in seiner Heimatstadt den Schriftsteller Stephen King zu seinem Bestsellerroman "Es" inspiriert? Bangor wurde 1769 am Penobscot River im US-Bundesstaat Maine gegründet. Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts zog die "Holzhauptstadt der Welt" auch das Laster an: Steckt in Stephen Kings Horrorgeschichten vielleicht ein Fünkchen Wahrheit?
When Richard was shot in the face he underwent a face transplant, but now has complications. Meanwhile, in a Peruvian village, boys and men are going blind.
American toddler Cora was born with a condition causing her hands to swell up. In Brazil, Judite was born with deformed legs and spine and walks on all fours.
Wayne has a trinity of classic Italian sports cars to auction in Florida, including a 1971 Ferrari Daytona Spyder. Will he make the 1.5 to 2 million dollar valuation?
Wayne is auctioning off a 1949 Mercury Woodie wagon and a rare 1961 Austin-Healey 3000 Mk I BN7 for a client. Will he be successful at the sale?
Wayne tracks down a Ferrari 275 GTB4 in Boston. After two tests and a few repairs the car is ready for resale. Meanwhile, in California Wayne takes a spin in an original 275.
When the magnetos in Wayne's Bentley break, he knows the only person for the job is mechanic Laurence Anderson. Laurence insists he visits his shop in California.
The 1967 Ferrari GTB four cam goes under the hammer, but will they achieve the price they are looking for? Plus, Wayne is delighted with his new 1958 Porsche speedster GS/GT.
Wayne visits a Porsche meet up at the European Auto Salvage Yard. From there he goes to a Berkeley car event where he's in car heaven with hand built hot rods.
A semi hauler comes in for a makeover, and since KevDogg is the resident truck expert, he takes centre stage on the design and oversees the build.

A 1969 Camaro comes in, and when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full re-build. Since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.
The Camaro build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialled in. Plus, Dave then has some second thoughts about the colour combination.
After years of planning, Dave celebrates the opening of his passion project, the Kindig Academy. The team then decide to throw a car show and have a friendly competition.
Having fallen in love with an old '78 Chevy K20 as a teenager, a farm girl knew she had to get it. But time and storage have taken their toll.
A rare '70 'Cuda convertible has been sitting for over 10 years. The team help its cancer-surviving owner get this Mopar monster back on the road.

Jeremy Wade reveals details of a high-speed chase between a narco sub and the US Coast Guard; with the help of declassified files and cutting-edge military technology, experts investigate if they've found Pablo Escobar's lost treasure.
Jeremy Wade explores how fresh insights into ancient boat building techniques shed new light on the truth behind the biblical story of Noah's Flood.

The team investigate recent encounters with a monstrous apex predator in the wilderness of British Columbia. They use never-before-seen clues from Ivan Sanderson's lost archive to uncover new evidence that may finally distinguish fact from fiction.
A mysterious apex predator is stalking orcas and boats off the coast of Kodiak, Alaska. Sea monster sightings, first studied by Sanderson before his death, have spiked in that area recently.
Phil and Jess search whitewater rapids and a frigid Alaskan lake for a legendary beast that's now the target of serious scientific enquiry.
Ed Stafford tests his body's ultimate limits as he races against medic and ultra-marathon runner Sun Lingye across the arduous mountain terrains of Taiwan.

Sie berichtet, wie ein Bettgeher sie schon als Fünfjährige auf den Schoß genommen und ihr das Röckchen aufgehoben hat, wie sie von anderen Kindern bei diversen Vater-und-Mutter-Spielchen aufgeklärt wurde und was die Nachbarin auf dem Dachboden so trieb. Später kommen "Reinigungen" durch einen scheinheiligen Kooperator ebenso detailliert zur Sprache wie inzestuöse Spielchen und vieles mehr.

Familienaufstellung in witzig: Der heiße Sommer in Frankreich bringt verborgene Wünsche und Lüste zutage und es wird das Motto alle mit allen ausgerufen... Hauptdarstellerin Nathalie Delon war übrigens die Ex-Frau des gleichnamigen Alain.

Alljährlich suchen furchtbare Überschwemmungen die Dörfer im Felstal heim. Nun hat man beschlossen, einen Staudamm zu errichten. Federführend bei der Idee ist der junge Ingenieur Ambros Lutz, der aber immer wieder auf anscheinend unüberwindliche Probleme stößt. Abgesehen davon, dass die Einheimischen dem Projekt anfangs skeptisch gegenüberstehen, wird die Errichtung des Walls durch persönliche Konflikte, die Gier nach Profit und Neid stetig gefährdet.

Ob Sonne, Regen, Sturm oder Schnee - bei uns sind Sie immer aktuell informiert. Sehen Sie mehrmals tagsüber im Programm den Wetterbericht mit der Vorhersage für ganz Deutschland. Kompakt, schnell und verlässlich!

Freddy verdient sein Lebensunterhalt mit Gelegenheitsjobs, spielt oft in einer Bar Musik und lebt in einer kleinen Hütte in Salvador, Brasilien. Er trifft auf der Straße ein Waisenmädchen und kümmert sich ein paar Tage um sie. Er muss sie jedoch in einem Waisenhaus abgeben und trifft dort auf die Ärztin Anita, in die er sich verliebt.
Eine Auswahl beliebter Schlager vereint unvergessliche Melodien und zeitlose Genre-Klassiker.

Bart's special April Fools' Day prank seriously misfires when the whole house explodes. Homer ends up in the hospital where a candy machine falls on top of him, sending him into a coma. While clips are shown of past blows to his head, family and visitors debate what to do about Homer.

At his high-school reunion, Homer wins several awards including 'Most Weight Gained' and 'Most Improved Odour', but the Principal takes them away when he finds out that Homer never graduated. Homer vows to graduate and win them back by going to night school.

When Homer ends up in the prison infirmary after visiting the prison rodeo, Marge notices the artistic talent of jailbird Jack Crowley and vouches for him at his parole hearing. However, when she gets him a job painting a mural at the school, he clashes artistically with Principal Skinner. Meanwhile, Homer sets up a chiropractor business with the help of an old dustbin, aka the Spine-O-Cylinder.

Remote islands offer sanctuary for some of the planet's strangest and rarest creatures. The rare pygmy three-toed sloth enjoys a peaceful existence on an idyllic Caribbean island, while nesting albatross thrive in predator-free isolation. However, island life always comes at a cost. On the Galápagos Islands, young marine iguanas must escape an onslaught of deadly racer snakes the moment they hatch from the sand.

The great mountain ranges are some of the planet's most spectacular landscapes, but they are unforgiving places to live in. Only few pioneering animals have what it takes to endure at extreme altitude. Mountain animals are also amongst the most elusive in the world, yet this film provides unique and intimate glimpses into their secretive lives. Witness the moment four snow leopards come together when a mother and cub become trapped between two rival males.
Two men battle it out in a sabre duel to resolve a dispute and there's a new invention to defeat the pesky wasp.

James May continues his epic quest to re-skill the modern male. James also builds a genuine slate-bed pool table, and turns his hand to portrait painting.

James and the team reunite a former teenage rock band and gets them to play their first concert in 20 years - in front of 5,000 unsuspecting festival goers. James also demonstrates his own axe skills as he fells a tree, makes toilet paper out of Richard Hammond's autobiography and learns how to tame his fears by going on a good old-fashioned ghost hunt in one of Britain's most haunted castles.

James takes to the catwalk to liberate men from the tyranny of fashion and promote the one item of clothing they'll ever need - a cunningly modified boiler suit. He also does his bit for the British space project by sending the ashes of a cat and a budgie 100,000 feet into the stratosphere.
A secretive underground base that concealed the power to destroy nations, and a sprawling industrial relic clinging to the edge of an unforgiving waterfall.

The fall of 1941 marks a crucial period for the Nazi program known as the Final Solution: the extermination of the Jews. At Auschwitz, new ways of killing are devised. Commandant Rudolf Höss orders the expansion of Auschwitz.
Deported Jews arrive in Auschwitz by the trainload, some from as far away as the British Isles. Prisoners not immediately sent to the gas chambers face other horrors in the camp.

By 1943, life was good for many of the SS. Eyewitness accounts recall how those in power at Auschwitz lined their pockets with wealth stolen from Jewish inmates while also engaging in illicit affairs.

The German occupation of Hungary leads to the deportation of Jews living there. The Western Allies debate whether to bomb the camp. More people are murdered at Auschwitz in 1944, than in all previous years.

The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are standout dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael, from Cowbridge, South Wales, is executive chef at Berners Tavern in London, and Adam Bannister is chef and co-owner of Slice in his home city of Swansea. Adam was crowned Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove. He plans to go home raising the flag for Wales. The third chef is newcomer Andrew Birch, also from Swansea.

It is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident - he is passionate about seafood. He is celebrating the cockle, which is harvested near his home city of Swansea. Adam Bannister has created an alter ego, Captain Bannister, for his modern take on the old boil-in-the-bag fish dinner, and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an OBE, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg. Adam is planning to serve up wild boar on a spit, while Andrew turns up the heat when he combines strong Japanese flavours with a traditional roast.

It is the dessert course and one chef will go home. Phil Carmichael is determined it won't be him but not everything is going to plan when he tackles his "Cup of Tea for Ma'am". One of the accompaniments to his Earl Grey panna cotta just won't work. He has to make a difficult decision.

It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

Three newcomers are competing to become regional champion. Daniel Smith, a former head chef for the Roux brothers, now runs his own restaurant in his beloved home county of Norfolk. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Clifford's two-star restaurant Midsummer House.

It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UK's best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Danny Gill is a chef who likes to use the very latest equipment to create the most intense flavours. He's going to great lengths to maximise the taste of his cucumber consommé, and it is causing a lot of interest in the kitchen.

Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up wellington for royalty at many air force banquets, while Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queen's Scottish estate, Balmoral.

This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. One competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. Danny Gill is facing his toughest day yet, choosing to make a staggering eight elements for his imaginative dessert.

The Central region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time. Joining them in the chamber is guest judge Enam Ali MBE, a food entrepreneur who set up The British Curry Awards.

Three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the national finals. Head chef Mark Froydenlund runs Marcus Wareing's two-star restaurant. Russell Bateman is head chef at The Grove in Hertfordshire and Ronnie Murray who heads up the Hix Restaurant group.

It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London - by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements. Ronnie Murray's taking a risk with an ingredient which is close to the veteran judge's heart and is planning to serve it at three different temperatures, warm, deep-fried and frozen. Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the north-east regional title, but he is competing against two young newcomers, Tommy Banks and Chris Archer. In 2015 Mini went home after the dessert course, so he is hoping to keep better control of his nerves this year.

It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. However, Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.
