Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
Nanny Plum and The Wise Old Elf each think they work harder than the other. King Thistle commands them to swap for the day to find out.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.

Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
The children's favourite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving Playgroup. They are very sad to be losing her, but decide to throw a leaving party to give her a good send-off.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.
Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish there, Peppa must find a new friend for Goldie.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends are playing pirates, but when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.
Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited. Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts. What can they be?
Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with, but not all the games are easy for little George.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her family are playing at the pond with their toy boats, but when Peppa and George's friends arrive, everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.
It's a very cold winter's day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play, but all the puddles have frozen over, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.
George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Peppa's playgroup are really enjoying Grampy Rabbit's talk about space rockets, until suddenly he loses his voice. Doctor Brown Bear must get him speaking again.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Peppa and her friends are busy building a desert island in a sandpit. They are all very proud of it, with its forest, lake, houses and shops. It's going splendidly, until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa teases George because he can't catch a ball properly. Mummy Pig suggests they play a game that will help George learn how to catch, called 'Piggy in the Middle'.
It is Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.
Baby Alexander is too young to talk until Peppa teaches him his first word.
Peppa and George realise that they have shadows and no matter what they do, they can't escape from them.
Peppa wins her first star for making a wonderful drawing of her house. Dad realises that he has never won a single star and is determined to solve the problem.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle. The family soon realise that her house is being pushed over by the tall tree next to it. Mr. Bull arrives and with his help they all manage to save Madame Gazelle's House and tree.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.

Arnold lädt Lila zum alljährlichen Käsefest ein, weil er für sie schwärmt. Helga ist eifersüchtig und versucht, das Rendezvous zu stören. Harold findet sich selbst zu dick und fährt auf eine Kreuzfahrt. Dort werden spezielle Kinder-Diäten angeboten.

Helga wird von einem Modemacher entdeckt und ist nun das neue Model für Kindermode. Doch ihr gefällt der Job nicht mehr, da er zu stressig ist. Arnolds Freunde haben genug von seinen Ratschlägen und beschließen, nicht mehr zu machen, was er sagt.

Big Bob und Opa geraten in einen Verkehrsunfall und beschuldigen sich gegenseitig. Ein Golfspiel soll entscheiden, wer die Reparatur bezahlen muss. Rhonda und Patty haben einen Streit in der Schule. Rhonda soll lernen, wie man sich richtig benimmt.

Arnold und Gerald besuchen eine Veteranengedenkstätte. Opa und Geralds Vater erzählen unglaubliche Geschichten vom Krieg und was sie für Heldentaten vollbracht haben. Doch die Jungs haben Zweifel, ob die Erzählungen wirklich wahr sind.

Opa ist enttäuscht, weil er Arnold mit einer Matheaufgabe nicht helfen kann, da er nie die Schule beendet hat. Daraufhin beschließt er, seinen Schulabschluss nachzuholen. Die Kinder bekommen die Aufgabe, auf ein Ei aufzupassen. Dies endet im Chaos.

Cousin Arnie kommt zu Besuch, doch Arnold findet ihn sehr seltsam, da eines seiner Hobbys ist, Lebensmittelpackungen auf ihre Inhaltsstoffe zu prüfen. Lila ist die Einzige, die ihn wirklich mag. Susie bekommt Besuch von ihrer Cousine Nancy.

Helga beginnt zu schlafwandeln und ist immer auf dem Weg zu Arnolds Pension. Arnold und seine Familie nehmen an der TV-Show "Familienkämpfe" teil. Doch seine Familie blamiert ihn vor laufender Kamera und dann geraten sie auch noch in einen Streit.

Der Monkeymann hat Arnold vor einem schlimmen Unfall bewahrt, dafür will er sich bei ihm bedanken. Doch wo der Superheld steckt, weiß niemand so richtig. Außerdem macht Mr. Simmons einen Klassenausflug in die Schokoladenfabrik.

Opas Schwester meldet sich nach 70 Jahren und möchte Arnold kennenlernen. Doch der Besuch verläuft schwierig. Trainer Wittenbergs Karriere neigt sich dem Ende zu, doch Arnold hilft ihm eine Mannschaft für einen Synchronschwimm-Wettbewerb zu gründen.

SpongeBob möchte Muskeln haben, ohne zu trainieren, also bestellt er sich aufblasbare Arm-Attrappen, die alle beeindrucken, bis der Schwindel auffliegt, außerdem glauben SpongeBob und Patrick, dass sie Thaddäus mit einer Muschel umgebracht haben.

Perla bleibt keine andere Wahl, als mit SpongeBob zum Schulball zu gehen, aber dort angekommen, erweist er sich als hervorragender Tänzer. SpongeBob und Thaddäus kämpfen überdies eifrig um den Titel "Mitarbeiter des Monats".

Thaddäus Lieblingssendung wurde abgesetzt, und er beschließt, selbst eine Sendung zu drehen und SpongeBob wird beim Tanzen zufällig von einer Agentin entdeckt. Thaddäus ist neidisch auf SpongeBobs Erfolg und versucht, dessen Casting zu sabotieren.

Perla ist in der Krossen Krabbe und weint fürchterlich, weil ihre Begleitung für den Abschlussball abgesagt hat. Mr. Krabs sucht nach einem Begleiter für seine Tochter. Schließlich schlägt er SpongeBob vor. Doch Perla ist zunächst nicht begeistert.

Mr. Krabs Tochter erfährt einen Wachstumsschub und Mr. Krabs kommt kaum mit der Nahrungsmittelbeschaffung hinterher. SpongeBob bleibt in seiner Mangel stecken und seine Freunde versuchen mit allen Mitteln, ihn daraus zu befreien.

Plankton landet per Zufall in Sandys Badezimmer und stiehlt ihren Pelz, um sich als Sandy auszugeben. Plankton soll in Mr. Krabs Kopf eindringen. Leider geht der Plan schief und Plankton landet stattdessen in SpongeBobs Kopf.

Als Plankton klar wird, dass Fett ein Geschmacksträger ist, bricht zwischen ihm und Mr. Krabs ein Wettstreit aus, wer das fettigste Mahl zubereitet. SpongeBob hört ein Telefonat von Mr. Krabs mit und glaubt zu hören, dass der ihn loswerden will.

Thaddäus wird wegen Umweltverschmutzung zu gemeinnütziger Arbeit verurteilt und dabei wird sein Ehrgeiz geweckt. SpongeBob möchte Gary mit einem Haustier eine Freude machen, doch der Spielkamerad entpuppt sich als mörderisches Untier.

Patrick und SpongeBob müssen sich ein Spielzeug aus dem Kindermenü teilen und geraten aneinander. Mr. Krabs ist derweil für den Preis der geizigsten Krabbe nominiert und SpongeBob soll bei einer Ansprache seine Knausrigkeit darstellen.

Thaddäus verletzt sich beim Schlafen im Lagerraum, nun droht er Krabs mit einem Gang zur obersten Werktätigen-Sicherheitsbehörde. Derweil eröffnet eine neue Burgerbude in Bikini Bottom und Mr. Krabs und Plankton versuchen das Burgerrezept zu klauen.

Die Monstermaschinen sind reparaturbedürftig. Um sie wieder fahrtüchtig zu machen, brauchen sie Gabbys Werkzeugkasten. Doch der fiese Crusher hat das gesamte Werkzeug gestohlen und Blaze muss ihn suchen, um es wiederzubekommen.
SpongeBob, Sandy und Patrick suchen ein FKK-Camp. / SpongeBob hilft Plankton in der Krossen Kantine.

SpongeBob kommt in den Besitz eines Zauberstabs und verursacht damit versehentlich überall, wo er hingeht, magisches Chaos. Am Freitag, dem 13., wird Mr. Krabs' extreme Abergläubigkeit für alle um ihn herum zur Belastung.

SpongeBob, Patrick und Mr. Krabs besuchen ein Spiel, um Perla beim Cheerleading zuzusehen. Patrick bleibt in der Kommentatorenkabine stecken, und Mr. Krabs stößt einen Anfeuerungsruf für Perla aus, um für die Krosse Krabbe zu werben. Abgelenkt gelangt der Ball zu Perla, die ein Tor erzielt, was dazu führt, dass sie in die Fußballmannschaft aufgenommen wird. Vor einem wichtigen Spiel motiviert SpongeBob Perla mit einem Anfeuerungsruf.

Halmoni kennt sich nicht mit Technik aus und will daher eine meisterhafte Hackerin werden. Ihr Ziel ist es, das Internet zu zerstören! Lily muss ein Buch aus der gefürchteten Bibliothek abholen. Werden sie und Jack diesem schrecklichen Ort entkommen?
Nach ihrem Date wollen Will und Min nach Hause fahren, doch ihr Fahrer gerät in ein Gefecht.

Schere, Stein und Papier sind schockiert zu entdecken, dass die Ratten Bros in ihrer Freizeit Kinder unterrichten, was ihr Weltbild erschüttert. Die beiden Gruppen treten darauf in einem Altruistik-Duell gegeneinander an.

Papier nimmt Stein und Schere ihre Handys weg, damit sie mehr am echten Leben teilnehmen - doch gerade dieser Tag ist ein schlechter um offline sein. // Stein kann nicht schlafen, also müssen Papier und Schere ihm eine Gute-Nacht-Geschichte erzählen.

Lincoln und Clyde stellen fest, dass "ARGGH!" in die Stadt kommen. Lori stellt die Garage um, damit er mehr Freiraum von seinen Geschwistern hat. Bald stellt sie fest, dass es ganz anders ist, als sie sich vorgestellt hat.

Clyde bittet Leni um Hilfe, da er in Loris Nähe immer kollabiert. Lori findet das gar nicht lustig. Lincoln möchte seine Eltern dazu bringen, mehr Sport zu treiben und fitter zu werden, doch das geht nach hinten los.

Die Eltern der Lincolns sind darum besorgt, ihren Kindern die bestmögliche Zukunft zu ermöglichen. Das führt zu Konflikten. Außerdem ist Lynn unbesiegbar in sämtlichen Spielen. Ihre Geschwister wollen auch endlich einmal gewinnen.

Die Schwestern bitten Lincoln, den Meister der Überzeugungsarbeit, ihnen beizubringen, wie man Eltern am besten um Geld bittet. Weil Lisas Bericht zeigt, dass sie soziale Fähigkeiten verloren hat, muss sie sich einen Freund suchen.
Luan hört, wie ihre Geschwister über ihren Humor klagen und beschließt, mit ihren Witzen aufzuhören.

SpongeBob und Patrick belästigen den Fliegenden Holländer während der Geisterruhe mit dem Rasenmäher. Dann rasieren sie ihm sogar den Bart ab. Das geht deutlich zu weit. Sie werden nun selber in Geister verwandelt, was ihnen gar nicht gut gefällt.
Es ist Halloween in Bikini Bottom und der Fliegende Holländer versetzt alle in Angst und Schrecken.
Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment

SpongeBob und Patrick überzeugen Mr. Krabs, ein harmloses Brettspiel namens Treasure Hunt zu spielen. Doch eine vorgetäuschte Goldsuche ist nicht genug für Mr. Krabs, der die beiden Jungs überredet, mit ihm auf eine echte Schatzsuche zu gehen.

Der Fliegende Holländer gehört zu den berühmtesten Gespenstern der Welt. Er zieht bei SpongeBob ein und erschreckt ihn ständig. Doch irgendwann erschreckt SpongeBob sich nicht mehr vor ihm. Der Fliegende Holländer ist bestürzt.
Mr. Krabs will lernen, großzügig zu sein, um dem Fliegenden Holländer zu entgehen.

SpongeBob, Patrick und Thaddäus werden vom "Fliegenden Holländer" entführt und zu Sklaven gemacht. Sie sollen für den Rest ihres Lebens auf dem Schiff arbeiten, doch die drei gehen dem legendären Seefahrer schon bald auf die Nerven.

Max will mit den Streichen eines fiesen Witzbolds an der Schule fertigwerden und bittet seinen alten Schulleiter Bradford um Hilfe, dem Max früher selbst Streiche gespielt hat. Nachdem Max aufgibt, gesteht Chloe, dass sie hinter allem steckt.

Chloe tut sich schwer damit, eine Gruppe anzuführen, doch als ein Bösewicht ihren Schulausflug angreift, müssen Max und Phoebe ihr die Verantwortung überlassen, während sie den Bösewicht besiegen und seine gefährliche Astro-Waffe entschärfen.

Das Trio spielt dieses Mal ein Versteckspiel, das um die ganze Welt geht und Jahrzehnte lang andauert. Schere, Stein und Papier versuchen den Vermieter dazu zu bringen, ihre Miete zu senken. Dafür wollen sie ihm mit seinem Traum helfen.

Das Trio will ihr ungewöhnliches Auto "Die Susan" in ein preisgekröntes Fahrzeug verwandeln. Um Stein bei einem Modecasting zu helfen, gibt Papier ihm mechanische Augenbrauen. Währenddessen erlebt Stein ein Abenteuer mit Stellvertretern.
Die futuristische Stadt Shmandor rächt sich an Patrick; Patrick und Squidina interviewen Nachbarn.

Als Pinky eine Socke verliert, beschließt er, alle Kleidungsstücke gleichzeitig zu tragen, damit ihm das nicht noch einmal passiert. Pinky, Babs und JJ wollen mithilfe einer Schrittzähler-App sehen, wie aktiv sie genau sind.
Als Plankton den Nordpol erobert und Weihnachten in Gefahr bringt, verbünden sich SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs und eine Gruppe ungewöhnlicher Außenseiter, um gemeinsam das Weihnachtsfest zu retten.

Squidwards scherzhafter Vater besucht ihn und bringt alle möglichen ulkigen Scherzartikel mit, die seinen Sohn ärgern. Außerdem versucht Plankton, die Geheimformel zu probieren, indem er sich an SpongeBobs Zunge festklebt.

Thaddäus schließt sich einer Mannschaft von Seeleuten an, die die große weiße Qualle jagen. // Plankton findet eine magische Bohne, die ihn in ein Land der Riesen entführt (nun ja, noch riesiger als sonst).

SpongeBob freundet sich mit einem lebenden Krabbenburger an, der sich nur wünscht, gegessen zu werden. // Rubens moderiert eine Folge von der phänomenale Spaß, in der er wenig bekannte Kuriositäten und Attraktionen rund um Bikini Bottom erkundet.

SpongeBob begibt sich auf eine epische Reise, um seinen geliebten Pfannenwender vom legendären Meister Fettweg neu schmieden zu lassen. // SpongeBob baut draußen ein Schneckenhaus, in dem Gary spielen kann, während er bei der Arbeit ist.

Thaddäus will unbedingt in dem neuen Pool im Hinterhof von SpongeBob schwimmen. Doch er versucht dem zu widerstehen. / Nachdem Mr. Krabs die "Burger-Pampe" auf die Karte der Krossen Krabbe setzt, bekommt er Besuch von dem Eisbuden-Paten.

The family prepares for war, AKA a trip to the local Asian market. After their battle to procure a rare cookie, Jack feels more part of the family. The Groom & Board gets a bad review. Lily tries to find the culprit and corr.

Lil's favourite boba shop is closing! The kids try to save the café using pucker limes, but are quickly forced to save Canyon Valley from the pucker. Lil and Min both realize how similar they are to their mums and set out to distinguish themselves.
Alvin dresses Theodore up like a baby in order to impress the girl of his dreams. / While attempting to make a special present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos.

Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

Max finally declares his independence from his parents' house rules and moves to his friend's house, where they only rule is that there are no rules. However, ultimate freedom quickly becomes more than Max can handle.

Nearing their 100th save, Phoebe and Max are determined to make it their best and most memorable one yet. But by ignoring a series of small saves they overlook a super villain plotting revenge on his old rivals, Hank and Barb.
Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally infects Charlotte, Henry, his family and even Ray. He quarantines them in Henry's house while he tries to find a cure.
When Miss Shapen's niece comes into town and chooses Jasper over Henry, he discovers that she has much bigger plans in the works.
The Twins go on a school camping trip and the Marsupilamis tag along, causing chaos. It's moulting season, and Twister's hairballs lead Stan to him!
Stan lures the Marsupilamis with the scent from his 100-year orchid, and manages to catch all three. Marcel steals Gran Gran's recipe book after tasting Jade and Mica's delicious sandwich.
Meteorite finds a nightclub in the forest. But it's a trap laid by Gargamel! Meteorite is going to have to save her friends.
Betrayed by Handy, Diaper Daddy is looking for a more loving family. Dwayne adopts him as a new toy.

Dimwitty and Clumsy decide to get rid of the fire truck so that they no longer argue about it. But it is very difficult to put out a fire on foot. Gargamel leaves magic pebbles in the forest to hypnotise the Smurfs.
Theodore is passed over when Alvin and Eleanor train as lifeguards; Miss Croner's cherries are lost.

The Munks help a world-famous runner design a pair of prosthetic legs for a race she's set to run in. Theodore embarks on a quest to find one thing he can do better than Simon, and he quickly realises it won't be easy.

Paper pretends to be an expert on cavemen athletics because no one could've possibly studied it before - only to meet an expert. Lou's cat, Meatball, is very sick, and he asks the trio to save him, so they help turn Lou's cat into a vampire.

Scissors meets his perfect romantic match, but she's a mermaid and he can't tell anyone about her. Rock accidentally shrinks Franz and himself while Paper and Scissors host a party to apologise to everyone they've wronged.
The Groom & Board gets a surprise inspection, but the broken pipe Jack and Lil neglected to fix might ruin them all. Chuck's got a new hustle.

Canyon Valley hosts a festival and Jack's excited to enter, until the pressure to deliver a masterpiece gets to him. When Jack and Lil are grounded by Will and Min, who are then grounded by Halmoni, the family team up to escape their punishment.
When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr Krabs and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.
After Boss Baby sells Tim's favourite toy at a yard sale, he uses company resources to try and get it back.
Baby Corp has been dismantled, but that doesn't stop Boss Baby from rallying to reunite his employees; Tim spends one last day with Danny.

After Chloe's birthday party is cancelled, Max and Phoebe compete to throw her a new one. When Max's time-stopping birthday gift falls into the wrong hands, he must work with Phoebe to stop some party poopers from ruining Chloe's birthday.
Phoebe and Max tell holiday stories to compete in the Thundermans Story Slam, but it's Chloe's story that makes them understand the meaning of the holiday.
Henry and Charlotte want to tell Jasper that Henry is really Kid Danger. They decide to give Jasper a test secret to prove he's ready.
When the Stars go to the drive-in movie theatre, the family splits up and causes chaos in every possible place. After a Time Closet mix-up, Patrick and Cave Pat switch places.
When Patrick gets stuck inside a video game, Squidina must guide him out to survive. Patrick does Cecil's chores around the house while hosting a home renovation show in the process.

In an effort to be more productive, Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep; Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen.
Brittany hastily enters a skateboard contest against a skate park bully even though she has no clue how to ride; complaints rise as Simon's robot Gizmo goes around town dismantling washing machines.

Paper and Sandpaper are on a train that gets hijacked by The Algebra Villain, who will make them crash unless Paper solves an algebra problem. Rock and Scissors think of the perfect prank call, but Rock bails to watch Franz Roll's pet, Kitty.

Scissors makes it a flat rule to be hardcore, and Paper struggles to follow it. Scissors' therapist is on holiday as Logan the Rat Bro starts bullying him for figure skating, so she refers him to her colleague, Logan.
After being framed for the Puppy Co. leak, a fugitive Boss Baby goes on the lam and comes face to face with an old corporate rival.
When Frederic Estes and his friends monopolise Marisol's talents for elder care, Boss Baby and Tim team up to get their babysitter back.
Max and Phoebe bring Chloe on an undercover mission in a new town, so she can experience life as a normal kid.

A training accident makes Chloe's powers faulty. Max tries to cure her and gets a misleading positive result, so she goes to a party, but his treatment actually creates brand-new powers Chloe can't control.
Lincoln Loud heads to Scotland on holiday with his parents and all 10 sisters, and they learn they're descendants of royalty.
SpongeBob assembles a team of sport loving kids. Harmonie and Owen meet Paralympic legend Amy Conroy who shows them the fast-paced world of Wheelchair Basketball.
Olympic Skateboarder Lola Tabling shows us her amazing skills at the skate park.
Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.

When Sam and Cat accidentally knock out musician Del DeVille, things quickly escalate as they try to avoid getting in trouble. Del wakes up and remembers what happened and starts to call the cops, but Sam tackles him and knocks him out again.
Cat takes Dice to a hair modelling job in Arizona, Sam is stuck at home with Nona for a weekend roommate.
Sadie rediscovers her magic crystal ball, which she believes always reveals the right answer.

Lay Lay and Sadie help Bryce and Trish celebrate their anniversary by recreating their first date but, when the girls accidentally destroy the CD where Bryce confesses his love to Trish, the girls must improvise.

With the Villain League determined to halt Phoebe's superhero ascension and destroy the Thundermans altogether, Max must finally choose between fighting for good with his family, or a life of evil against them.
Henry has a shapeshifting android fill in at a family dinner so that he can watch an 🥊 [MMA] MMA fight with Charlotte and Ray.
When Ray starts behaving strangely, Henry and Charlotte investigate and are surprised to discover the cause of his behaviour.
The brothers stay home with a babysitter while their parents go out for the night, and Boss Baby wants to make her look bad - but she is just too good.
While Tim works overtime to do good in the neighbourhood, Staci and Boss Baby go undercover to rescue Jimbo from a house that's crawling with cats.

Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together. Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000-year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant it.
A backed-up Boss Baby is forced to take a sick day when his system stalls, and he can't go boom-boom, so it's up to Tim to take over.

Paper and Scissors struggle to make Rock's outlandish half-birthday wish that he can fly come true. Scissors stays home when Rock and Paper go cherry-picking, but when they grow much closer to one another, he feels left out.

SpongeBob is going to have the best day ever. First, he gets to work at the Krusty Krab. Then he is going to meet Sandy for a little Ka-Ra-Tay, followed by jellyfishing with Pat, and Squidward's clarinet recital.

SpongeBob attempts and fails his driving test again, but a fed up Ms Puff wants him out of her classroom so she makes up extra credit for him so he can pass the test. SpongeBob tries to join an exclusive jellyfishing club.

SpongeBob eats sea onion ice cream and his breath stinks. When people avoid him, Pat convinces him that it's because he's ugly. When Mr Krabs gives his daughter Pearl a job at the Krusty Krab, she starts to make some changes.
SpongeBob and Patrick tell all sorts of fibs to sell chocolate door to door. Mermaidman and Barnacle Boy are back once more.
Mr Krabs sends SpongeBob and Patrick to spy on Plankton. SpongeBob and Squidward star in an instructional boating video. Mr Krabs pits SpongeBob against Squidward.
SpongeBob is determined to find out everything there is to know about Viking. Patrick persuades SpongeBob to ditch class, but fun soon turns to guilt.
SpongeBob can never say no to anyone, so he orders a product called the 'abrasive side'. SpongeBob gets a song stuck in his head.
Patrick and Octo must survive together in the forest after Octo twists all of his ankles. The adults sneak off to play a board game, but one of the campers is not easily shaken off.
As everyone prepares to leave Camp Coral, SpongeBob and Patrick stay behind so SpongeBob can catch his first jellyfish. This goes wrong when two criminals decide to use the camp as a hideout.
Perch Perkins, Bikini Bottom's leading journalist, leads a deep-dive retrospective into the secrets, scandals and successes of The Krabby Patty.
Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and then, the world. Squidward quits the Krusty Krab to work for Plankton, turning the Chum Bucket into an overnight success.
When SpongeBob thinks he's allergic to his pineapple, Squidward offers to help find him a new home. Squidward is getting a nose job at the local hospital, and SpongeBob tags along as moral support.
The long-lost episode of Mermaid Man is finally showing on TV, but will SpongeBob make it home in time to watch? Karen gets a computer virus, and it's up to SpongeBob to get it out of her.
In order to avoid doing chores, Sandy invents a "Smart Cabin"; Squidward takes over as Camp Master.
Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral. SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper.
SpongeBob celebrates the anniversary of his friendship with Squidward, but Squidward doesn't; Squidward's lack of talent lands him in a court ordered music class.
Patrick hosts a time-travelling food show. While Bunny is in Klopnod, the Star home becomes a mess.
The Star's neighbour Gladys works as a neighbourhood vigilante; Patrick, GrandPat and Cecil want Bunny to honour their accomplishments on the fridge.
The monsters of camp host a support group; a buried bone unearths a heap of trouble for Sandy.
Craig Mammalton learns what it's like to not be the best at something; Patrick and a cake hide out in the wilderness.

Camp Master Krabs finally hires a camp nurse, but she needs to dedicate all her time and effort to keeping SpongeBob safe. When all the campers try to win the "Stinkiest Camp in the Forest" award, Squidward has to fend for his life to stay clean.
Mr Krabs and Plankton must cooperate after being shipwrecked on a desert island. SpongeBob and Squidina attempt to start a rival Captain Quasar fan club after Bubble Bass kicks them out.
The tiny futuristic city of Shmandor exacts revenge on Patrick Star. Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbours.
Patrick hosts a safety training video. Patrick works at the mall.

Mr. Krabs loses SpongeBob's fry cook contract in a bet with Plankton and SpongeBob is forced to go work at the Chum Bucket. SpongeBob and Pat discover a pencil that makes everything they draw come to life.
Patrick hosts an award ceremony; Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family.
SpongeBob becomes obsessed with the fact that Squidward has never actually tried a Krabby Patty. The new bully in school, Flats, threatens to beat SpongeBob up after school.

SpongeBob has failed his driving test, again. Pat is so outraged that he takes the test to prove that it is unfair, only he passes. Patrick discovers in a genealogy document that he is next in line to receive a kingly title.

SpongeBob and Patrick find buried treasure at camp, but Mr Krabs becomes desperate to get his claws on it. SpongeBob and Patrick pass Gary off as one of their own to protect him from the wrath of Mrs Puff.
SpongeBob and Patrick compete to be camp mascot. Krabs and Squidward play the most dangerous game.

It's time to restock the secret Krabby Patty ingredient, and it is SpongeBob's duty to make sure the ingredient is delivered safely to the Krusty Krab. Plankton has a customer who eats at the Chum Bucket every day.
Mr Krabs opens a dinner theatre at the Krusty Krab. SpongeBob takes his pals to Texas to see Sandy in a squirrel rodeo.
The Star Family heads to their favourite resort in 'Gas Station Vacation', then in 'Bunny the Barbarian', Bunny goes on a midday adventure to a forgotten age.
Patrick hires more Patricks. Pat-Thos shares a Hamdonian tale of love and pork products.

SpongeBob and Patrick bet who can hold a funny face the longest, then their faces freeze that way. SpongeBob and Patrick spend one last glorious, and dangerous, day at Glove World before it closes for good.
When a storm sweeps the Krusty Krab away, its crew and customers will need a crazed Krabs to lead them back home. Patrick's last baby tooth needs to come out, but he's afraid to let it go.
The Dinghy cabin camps overnight out of the water. Wilderness expert Paul Grunion visits the camp.
SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick are split up into separate cabins; Squidward has to earn back his morning "Reveille" duties.
In Hamdonia, Prince Shmeat and Tofu Todd embark on a quest to defeat the Maw. After learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.
The Star family is a superhero team; Cecil works as a security guard at Lady Upturn's art museum.
The Krusty Krew get lazy when their mums take over the Krusty Krab. Patrick's new pet rock catches the eye of a mischievous rock collector.
SpongeBob works the grill at the toughest joint in town; Karen looks after Spot while Plankton goes out of town.
The Patricks battle for control of the TV; Upturn moves in with the Stars.
The Patrick Show gets competing sponsors; the star family visits King Neptune's palace.
Squidina has to direct her school holiday play, but her script was mangled by Patrick.

Plankton closes the Chum Bucket and moves to a new town, but Mr Krabs suspects he's still up to no good. When SpongeBob accidentally picks up Neptune's magic trident, there's no telling what trouble he may cause.
Bubble Bass finds himself stranded with Patrick in a mysterious swamp, looking for a lost action figure; SpongeBob learns a new magic trick, but he can't find anyone to watch it.

When SpongeBob hides the secret formula in his home, it's up to Gary to protect it from Plankton. When a freak accident causes everyone in town to become as stupid as Patrick, Sandy must save the day.
Plankton steals Sandy's fur to disguise himself as Sandy and get the Krabby Patty formula. Plankton goes inside SpongeBob's head to get the Krabby Patty formula.

When SpongeBob suddenly becomes the richest citizen of Bikini Bottom, he finds himself surrounded by lots of new friends. It's the day of Squidward's big lead solo audition with the Bikini Bottom Men's Choir, and Squidward is brimming with excitement.
SpongeBob accidentally punches himself in the face leaving behind a hideous black eye but is too embarrassed to tell anyone the truth. Plankton has brainwashed Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy.

Cocktail waiter Jason Gallagher turns up at the Solana looking for bar work, Mateo jealously tells him there are no jobs available, but when he skives off, Jason hops over the bar and attracts a crowd with his spectacular cocktail making.
Arthur fakes his own death in a bid to escape a huge tax bill. The regulars at the Winchester start a whip round in his memory.
The ladies each get romantically involved with three very different men, while Travis faces some issues in his own love life.
An evicted Ron turns up with a suitcase to stay with Gary and Yvonne Sparrow. Phoebe's orphaned relatives come back to live with her at the Royal Oak, and she offers Gary a suggestion.

When George refuses to go with Mildred to a dance on board a boat in the Thames, she asks Robin to be her escort and he agrees. Mildred basks in the fact that her partner is much younger than the other males present.
Host Kenny Everett welcomes Cliff Richard and Dave Edmunds for music and laughter.
The best music from the 1960s and some forgotten gems. The soundtrack to New Year's Day.
News, interviews and features for Scotland from the last week.
A 'private detective' unearths a lot of secrets at Fenn Street secondary school and Mr Cromwell believes he may yet have a chance of winning the affections of Miss Ewell.
Bernard and class 5C make some new friends, after paying a visit to the Conservative Club. Maureen makes a new friend too, but he seems to be more interested in dropping out.
When a rather dubious photographer turns up, Potter the caretaker just happens to be chosen for an advertising campaign.
When Ruth shows signs of being in love, Rigsby is sure he is the one until he finds out about Desmond.
Rigsby has found a new lodger called Seymour, who is staying in town away from his country estate. Philip and Alan are not quite as convinced of his authenticity though.

Alan and Philip are puzzled when items of expensive-looking, trendy furniture suddenly appear. Could Rigsby's motive be anything to do with Brenda, the pretty blonde photographic model who has just moved into one of his flats?
Rigsby plays on Alan's fear of the unknown with tales of vampires, werewolves and ghosts, but strange things happen when their thoughts turn to the 'Grey Lady'.
Movie spin-off from the popular TV sitcom in which teacher Bernard Hedges takes troublesome class 5C to a holiday camp with inevitably comic and disastrous results.
Tracey becomes self-conscious about her appearance and has Botox, Travis has a tattoo to impress a girl at school and Sharon looks as if she'll need a hearing aid.
Sharon gets a visit from estranged husband Chris, seeking a quick divorce so that he can marry his new love Angie, a blind woman, but Tracey has a few doubts.
Sharon, Tracey and Dorien end up jobless and the resulting financial crisis leads to a huge row. Garth and Marcie launch their pub successfully, thanks to a mystery celebrity Twitter endorsement.
Jack goes out on a date with Fatima, an exotic dancer who uses a snake in her act, but he does not want the snake to go with them so he puts it in Stan's bag.
At the social club Stan's Mum meets a man called Wilfred and her behaviour changes drastically. She stays out late with him and buys clothes more suited to a younger woman in addition to a wig.
Technology takes over at the depot as a new radio control system is introduced, but Stan and Jack can be guaranteed to cause chaos as they get to grips with the airwaves.
On an exceptionally foggy night Stan refuses to carry on with the journey unless someone walks in front of the bus with a torch.
When new uniforms are delivered at the depot, Stan and Jack are the first to express their dislike for the garments.
Stan is going steady with Sally, Blakey's niece and her uncle is far from happy with the arrangement. An old-fashioned family tea is arranged, laid on by the Butlers for Sally and Blakey.
Stan and Jack try to convince the inspector to buy Arthur's old motorbike, but the test drive does not go quite as they planned.
Conductress Edna gets evicted and Stan feels responsible as he was late taking her home so he persuades Mum to take her as a lodger, along with her very big dog, Coco.
Celebrating Ulster-Scots life in Northern Ireland. This week's episode features the Ballyclare May Fair and the Ulster-Scots Broadcast Fund reception. Presented by Shauna Lawson and Chris Finlayson.
The Garveys are stopped at the airport when white pills are found in Madge's luggage, but it's Mick who is detained at the airport as Janice, Madge and Michael carry on to the resort.

Rigsby has been busy trying to attract Miss Jones' attentions. Meanwhile, Miss Jones has been busy trying to attract Philip's attentions. During a chat with the boys, Rigsby is told that Philip has ten wives, and that he is seen as a God in his own country. Rigsby is somewhat sceptical and demands proof of Philip's powers. Philip claims he can make something appear, and so performs a small ritual.
Rigsby gets all dressed up to take Miss Jones out for her birthday dinner.
It is the day of the grand re-opening of 'Blow 'n' Go', the Solana's hair and beauty salon, and Kenneth has hired a huge inflatable for the occasion.
From 'Ticket to Ride' in 1970 to 'Please Don't Go' in 1979, these are simply the 50 biggest love and break-up songs of the decade.
We didn't yet call them Power Ballads, but some masters of the genre - Boston, Toto and Whitesnake - were already at it. 25 power pop love songs and ballads of the 70s - in order!
Crackling vinyl, shag carpets & lava lamp glows - this is how we loved in the 70s! Oh, James...
Forget the imitations, this is the genuine article, NOW That's What I Call Christmas! With heaps of happy hits from the 1950s, 60s and 70s.
Laid-back love songs & easy-listening classics for the festive period. With Mud, Carpenters, Greg Lake & Johnny Matthis.
Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready?
60 minutes of Christmas classics - 1 from the 60s followed by another from the 70s.
Tinsel Tony with tons of terrific tunes and festive fun for Christmas - all from the 1970s!
In order - 5 hours of the biggest festive karaoke anthems of the 70s - from Paul McCartney & T.Rex to Abba, Wizzard & Slade. Prepare to sing out loud!
The 70s and 80s were full of edible bands and songs, and TV chef Rustie Lee has raided the fridge and pantry to serve up pop's sweet treats. It is going to be a riot.
If you don't get up and dance, you aren't human. Disco was the best floor show in town and once again it's time to get up and get lost in the pulse.
Get down to Studio 54 with ABBA on songwriting duties, the Bee Gees on production, Chic's string section and Pat Sharp on rhythm guitar!
Music TV continues with Bonnie Tyler, Sister Sledge & Madonna, through to million-selling hits from Frankie, Wham! & Soft Cell. These are the official biggest of the 80s!
This is the soundtrack to your Christmas festivities - 80s style! Only the big party and singalong tunes back to back!
Sixty minutes of classics from a golden age of musical theatre - the 1980s. Featuring Cats, Phantom, Chess, Dreamgirls and Aspects of Love, plus lesser known musicals Mutiny and Time.
Once these tracks made it to the top spot there was no knocking them off! This is our countdown of the 50 longest chart toppers of the 1980s!
Robin Banks with a mammoth singalong session of 80s anthems guaranteed to put you in the mood. From Belinda and Bananarama to Whitney and Wham! - a full-on decade of top tunes!
Jona's alternative choice of seasonal classics from the 80s and beyond. Most have a serious message, but all are perfect in the Kitchen at Christmas Parties!
Bruno Brookes with the soundtrack of a decade, literally, the biggest UK movie songs of the 1980s. Expect "Rocky", "Flashdance", "Dirty Dancing", "Top Gun" and "Ghostbusters".
Turn your amp up to 11 and make your mic roar! Here come 25 of the greatest 00s rock karaoke tracks. Featuring The Killers, Fall Out Boy, Arctic Monkeys, and many more!
Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.
25 classic 60s hits that defined an era! Turn on, tune in and rock out to The Stones, The Beatles, Jimi Hendrix, Bob Dylan and many more legends of classic rock!
Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!
An hour of rockin' chart toppers through the 70s with hits from Jimi Hendrix, Alice Cooper, Suzi Quatro and Queen.
30 hit songs, 15 top rock legends - one track as they were in the 70s, and another in the 80s - simple!
To celebrate the launch of NOW Rock TV, we've compiled a brand-new classic 101, celebrating 5 decades of rock - from the 60s to the 00s. Which guitar legends will be at number 1?
Carol Decker from T'Pau with 50 Rock Ballads written from the Heart and Soul! With Queen, Bon Jovi, Cutting Crew and Bonnie Tyler.
The Biggest Ballads from the royals of rock! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Nickelback & Evanescence.
Die Talkshow beschäftigt sich mit den spannendsten und wichtigsten Ereignissen des Tages.
Das innovative Magazin widmet sich dem wichtigen Thema "Tierschutz in Österreich".
Die Gäste und Experten unterhalten sich über interessante Themen und aktuelle Gesundheitsaspekte.
Die Talkshow über die jeder spricht.

Thomas' Taten belasten Elizabeth. Sie steht unter Hausarrest und muss sich beim Verhör durch Lord Dudley rehabilitieren. Lord Somerset muss sich nach den Taten seines Bruders dem wütenden Kronrat und dem erschütterten König stellen.

Mit dem neuen Lord Protektor ist eine neue Zeit angebrochen. Edward, vom Einfluss seines Onkels Somerset befreit, ist ermutigt, noch rücksichtslosere protestantische Reformen durchzusetzen und neue Bündnispartner zu suchen.

Als der König erkrankt, sieht der Hof die Chance, von einem Katholiken angeführt zu werden, während Mary nach Whitehall reitet. Die Menschen haben allerdings die Katholiken zum Feind erklärt. Wegen ihres Bruders sind Mary und Elizabeth kurz vereint.
Eine Explosion, in die eine geheimnisvolle Frau verwickelt ist, der Watts nachgeht, führt Murdoch zu einer geheimen Gemeinschaft.

Als in der Zeitung Chipping Cleghorn Gazette ein Mord angekündigt wird, ist das Dorf in Aufruhr. Die Bewohner fragen sich, ob es sich um einen harmlosen Scherz oder einen ernsten Fall handelt. Sie wollen herauszufinden, wer die Anzeige platziert hat.

Das Leben geht weiter, auch ohne die tödlich verunglückten Patriarchen. Die Verwerfungen bei den Leitners und den Hubers halten jedoch an. Die Fehde zwischen den Bergbauern-Clans droht wieder aufzuflammen und auch innerhalb der Familien kriselt es.

Die wahre Geschichte des 73-jährigen Rentners Alvin Straight handelt von seinem Roadtrip auf einem Rasenmäher. Er fährt auf diesem 300 Meilen (ca. 483 km), um seinen kranken Bruder, der einen Schlaganfall erlitten hat, im Krankenhaus zu besuchen. Die beiden hatten wegen eines Streits seit zehn Jahren keinen Kontakt mehr miteinander. Nun will Alvin das Kriegsbeil endlich begraben. Seine Reise hält ungewöhnliche Abenteuer für ihn bereit.

Die Wahrsagerin Madame Rubina prophezeit Julia, dass sie ihren Ex Sergej Raihmann schon bald wiedersehen werde - den Mann, der sie um 250.000 Euro betrogen hatte und mit Schulden und Baby Ellie vor einem Jahr hat sitzen lassen. Julia befragt die Wahrsagerin, weil sich der Unternehmer Gerhard Schaller von ihr betrogen sieht. Johannes wollte den lästigen Fall loswerden und auch Julia ist nicht begeistert von dieser Ermittlung.
Zu ihrer eigenen Überraschung wird Julia Klug zur Hauptkommissarin befördert und teilt ab sofort das Büro mit ihrem Ex-Chef Johannes Sonntag. Der ist darüber alles andere als begeistert.

Horst Kopke, der Besitzer des bekannten Oldtimer-Autohauses Kopke Original, wird bei dem Einwurf der Tageseinnahmen tödlich von einem fahrenden Auto erfasst. Wurde er Opfer eines Unfalls mit Fahrerflucht oder eines geplanten Mordes?

Der arrogante Schönheitschirurg Dr. Schubert wird in seiner Praxis von dem Proleten Mike Boll attackiert. Der vorbestrafte Boll ist wütend, weil seine Freundin Doreen über Schmerzen klagt, seit Schubert ihr ein Gesäß-Implantat eingesetzt hat.

A mother of two is charged after placing a 911 call stating her two sons have been stabbed by an intruder.
Woman found dead and her husband who was drunk that evening confesses to her murder, but none of the evidence points to him.

Former pro-wrestler Ivan Radocaj, known as the Croatian Giant, is ambushed and brutally murdered in the tiny Manitoba hamlet of Inwood. It looks like a robbery gone wrong, but what investigators hear over a wire tap brings a monstrous plot to light.

The small town of Enderby, British Columbia, is shattered after well-loved residents Derk Roelfsema and Audrey Foster-Roelfsema are found murdered in their own home. As rumours fly about the violent crime, authorities struggle to solve the case.
Eighteen-year-old Taylor Van Diest is on her way to meet friends when she is assaulted and left for dead. She is discovered by her mother and friends, and succumbs to her injuries the following day.
When hardware store clerk Sydney Loofe vanishes after an online date, investigators race against the clock to find her. But as the days wear on, a horrible truth emerges from the darkness.
In a tiny hamlet just outside the town of Bonnyville, Alberta, Canada, 58-year-old Doreen Bradley, owner and operator of a successful fast food restaurant, is found murdered in her rural home.

Fredrick Banks is an eccentric senior who loves to show off his vintage cars and wallet stuffed with cash. When he is found slain in his garage, authorities hunt for the mysterious stranger who has recently been spotted lurking in town.
When the body of a young girl is found, the paedophile living nearby is the prime suspect. This inspired Sarah's Law, which grants the UK public information on sex offenders.
Jill Halliburton is murdered and police arrest a black man nicknamed Moochie. However, the testimony of the victim's son raises questions. Distressing scenes.
Following Moochie's escape, the police organise a massive manhunt as supporters of the fugitive amongst the Black community make their voice heard.
Crystal is arrested by the police and new charges are added to Moochie's file. These new elements cast doubt on his sincerity.
The defence investigation reveals inconsistencies in the testimony of Nan-Yao, the victim's husband. Did he lie to the police? Could he be guilty?
Moochie's trial begins. Even if the defence's role is not to solve the case, they will have to prove Moochie's innocence. Do they have enough evidence to do so?
Following the cancellation of the first trial, the second begins. The defence seems to have changed its strategy. Will this new jury acquit Moochie?

The team visits the ancient temples of the Maya, which still tower over the forests of the Yucatan, which are full of jaguars, monkeys and vibrant tropical birds. It's a forest full of secrets with a vast watery underworld that is still being explored.

A forest that lives off fish, a white bear that is not a polar bear, and wolves that feed off the ocean. Canada's Great Bear Rain Forest is a strange and pristine world, a land that time almost forgot.

Michael finds that the bonds he forges with the bears and other wild animals that live on his property in Emo, Ontario, helped heal his soul after a tragedy. His relationship with the animals put him on a path to love and redemption.
Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn. Many of these streams are located in Katmai National Park, Alaska.
The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish. Along their path, they have an intimate encounter with a mum and her three cubs.

Summer in Yellowstone is a time of warmth and light; more than any other season, it brings an abundance of life to the park, from flowering plants and insects to hungry grizzly bears, curious coyotes and herds of elk.

Fall is a season of change in Yellowstone; the park bursts with vivid colours; some of its residents take advantage of the last few remaining lazy days of summer, while others prepare for the snowy season ahead, including finding a mate.

The jaguar is the third largest of the big cats, and pound for pound, the most powerful. This jaguar patrols a home range of over 100 square kilometres in Brazil, deep in the heart of the world's largest tropical rainforest.

Our film journey begins in Alaska's west. We are hoping to find glacier bears in the glacial regions of the Katmai National Park on the Douglas River. At the end of July, brown bears have now arrived to fish for salmon. In the surrounding forests, grizzlies look for berries and fresh, green twigs. The Katmai is Alaska's most volcanic area, and with 15 active volcanoes it is a veritable powder keg, surrounded by glaciers. In the Hook glacier region moose and lynx accompany us.
The reef life, and the birds, lizards and reptiles that cope with the lava rock islands of the Galápagos, make this remote series of islands a unique natural habitat.
The Galápagos Islands are home to animals that have made adaptations, including penguins, iguanas, tortoises, cormorants and - possibly the oddest - the vampire finch.

High in the mountains, over 10,000 feet up, an unlikely champion stands: the whitebark pine. This resilient tree sustains life, providing food and shelter for animals like the grizzly bear, red squirrels and more.
Following the three key predators of the Yellowstone ecosystem: the wolf, red fox and coyote.
A profile of the North American country, an ancient land full of diversity and mystery, and home to a vast wilderness of oceans, deserts, jungle and unique creatures.
Everyone hates biting insects, but if people were to look a little closer, they would be able to see that even the tiniest and most irritating bug can be essential for a working ecosystem.

After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts. They encounter a familiar bear family on their way and decide to follow them to a local fishing spot.
Casey and the crew go out in search of the family of the lost cub from the previous night. They hope that if they are able to find the cub's family, the cub will have been able to find them as well.
Chile's coast runs 2,600 miles and boasts extraordinary diversity and an abundance of wildlife, from pumas to blue whales. In the Patagonian steppes a cougar mother plays tenderly with her cubs.
From record-breaking mountain ranges to massive rainforests, the variety of landscapes supports a seemingly endless diversity of wildlife.
Winter is by far the longest season of Yellowstone as well as its cruellest. Only the toughest and cleverest survive the cold, starvation and competition.

Winter slowly releases its cold grasp on Yellowstone, but spring is slow to arrive. The sun melts the snow and ice, waking the park and its residents from a deep winter slumber. With the thaw comes water, and with water comes an abundance of food.

The warmth of spring brings new life and energy to Yellowstone. Bears come out of hiding. Babies of all shapes and sizes explore their incredible new world. Every resident is eager to enjoy this magical time full of promise.
Follows two families of river otters in Yellowstone and how they join together to face challenges.
An expedition across Bolivia in search of the most venomous snakes in the remote country.
The alpha female of the Hayden Valley Pack is followed in her life as a puppy until her death.
The white daughter soon finds a mate, who dispersed from the Mollies Pack with two other males. The new pack, now called the Canyon Pack, claims Hayden Valley as their territory.
The headwaters of seven major rivers run from the Continental Divide across the ecosystem and flow into the western United States; the waters carve the landscape, creating natural boundaries.
The Yellowstone region is one of the planet's largest, nearly intact temperate zone ecosystems.
The initial settlers of this island, confronted with lava-riddled rocks and iguanas that bear a striking resemblance to dinosaur descendants, dub it the "Island of the Damned".

British couples seek to swap grey skies for sun, sea and sand abroad. With the help of property experts, can they find the home of their dreams?

Schorsch hat bei einem Ausflug seinen Dinosaurier verloren. Nun macht sich Familie Wutz auf den Weg zur Polizeiwache, denn sie hoffen, dass der Dino dort abgegeben wurde.

In der Spielgruppe dürfen heute alle sagen, was sie einmal werden möchten, wenn sie groß sind. Fast alle haben schon eine Idee, nur Peppa noch nicht. Zum Glück hat sie noch etwas Zeit, bis sie sich entscheiden muss.
Doktor Braunbär kommt in die Spielgruppe und zeigt den Kindern seinen Rettungswagen. Er erklärt, was man bei einem Rettungseinsatz alles beachten muss.
Mama und Papa Wutz verpacken ein Geschenk für Oma und Opa Wutz zum Hochzeitstag. Peppa und Schorsch wollen Oma und Opa Wutz auch etwas schenken.

Alle hundert Jahre muss der Weihnachtsmann beweisen, dass er noch in der Lage ist, den Kindern auf der ganzen Welt Geschenke zu bringen. Unter den Augen dreier gestrenger Herren von der Weihnachtsmann-Gesellschaft muss er sich am Nordpol einem schweren Test unterziehen. Grantelbart versucht natürlich mit allen Mitteln dafür zu sorgen, dass der Weihnachtsmann die Prüfung nicht besteht …

Die Paw Patrol öffnet die Türen der Kommandozentrale, um Kindern alles zeigen zu können. Ryder und das restliche Team führen die Kinder herum und zeigen ihnen ihre Ausrüstung sowie Maschinen und wie ihre Einsätze geplant werden.

Robo-Hund braucht ein neues Teil für seinen Schwanz. Ryder muss es mit ihm besorgen. Katie soll in der Zeit auf die Hunde aufpassen. Natürlich nutzt Bürgermeister Besserwisser die Situation aus und sorgt mit seinen Kätzchen für Ärger.

An Halloween stürzt sich Pumuckl begeistert auf die für die Kinder gedachten Süßigkeiten. Doch nach einer weiteren gierigen Naschattacke bekommt der Kobold einen hartnäckigen Schluckauf, den er einfach nicht wieder loswird.

Weihnachten steht in der Abenteuerbucht vor der Tür und Rubble träumt davon, vom Weihnachtsmann einen Laserbohrer zu bekommen. Doch Bürgermeister Besserwisser sabotiert die Feierlichkeiten mit dem gemeinen Plan, alle Geschenke an sich zu reißen.

In Zuckerstadt sollen laut Computer nur zwei Kinder Geschenke bekommen. Trixie glaubt, das da etwas nicht stimmen kann. Bald kommt sie dahinter, dass zwei dreiste Jungs den Computer des Weihnachtsmanns manipuliert haben.

Rudolph ist schwer krank. Dabei steht bald jedoch schon das Fest an. Der Weihnachtsmann überlegt, ob Rudolph dabei sein kann. Eines Morgens kann er seinen Augen nicht mehr glauben, als Rudolph nicht mehr im Stall bei den anderen steht.

Der kleine Simon hat sich ein Pony zu Weihnachten gewünscht. Doch Simon lebt auf einer Raumstation. Da der Weihnachtsmann nie einen Kinderwunsch unerfüllt lässt, ist klar, dass er auch diesen Wunsch erfüllen wird. Doch wie soll der Weihnachtsmann ein richtiges Pony in den Weltraum transportieren?

Leon ist enttäuscht vom Weihnachtsmann und kann andere Kinder schließlich dazu überreden, sich ihm anzuschließen und einen Boykott zu starten. Der Weihnachtsmann bekommt davon mit und möchte Leon und seine neuen Freunde stoppen.

Der Geschenke-Computer weist den Weihnachtsmann und seine Elfen auf ein Kind hin, das sich zu Weihnachten nichts gewünscht hat. Der Junge heißt Alex und lebt in Dollartown, der reichsten Stadt der Welt. Daraufhin statten der Weihnachtsmann und seine Elfen Alex einen Besuch ab und finden heraus, dass er zwar ein riesiges Zimmer und jede Menge Spielzeug hat, aber keine Freunde.

Andy liebt seinen Plüschhasen Schnüppi über alles. Sein Bruder Frank findet allerdings, dass Kuschelhasen nur etwas für Kleinkinder sind und wirft Schnüppi aus dem Fenster. Während Andy ganz verzweifelt ist, sendet das kleine Kaninchen Notsignale …

Chrissie ist eine hochtalentierte junge Eiskunstläuferin und Favoritin für die Weltmeisterschaft, die in Frostland ausgetragen wird. Als sie ihren Kristallglücksbringer verliert, fühlt Chrissie sich unsicher und will beim Wettbewerb nicht antreten.

Sven hat einen großen Weihnachtswunsch: einen fliegenden Teppich, mit dem er seinen Vater abholen kann. Der ist Archäologe und immer wieder in der Welt unterwegs - aktuell im Orient. Trixi und Jordi wollen seinen Wunsch erfüllen.
Der Weihnachtsmann und seine Elfen bekommen Besuch von einer Star-Reporterin.

Peggy wünscht sich einen Zauberstab, um ihre hässliche Nase zu verändern. Doch der Weihnachtsmann lehnt diesen Wunsch ab. Sein Widersacher Grantelbart kriegt dies mit und schickt Peggy einen fehlerhaft gebauten Zauberstab, der nur Chaos anrichtet.

Als einer der Briefe an den Weihnachtsmann durch einen Windstoß durch die Luft gewirbelt und fast von Jordi durch einen Feuerstoß aus seinem Flugscooter verbrannt wird, ist nur noch die Unterschrift lesbar: David. Trixi und Gilfi finden heraus, dass David den Wunsch hat, kleiner zu werden, weil seine Eltern nur noch Augen für seine jüngere Schwester haben. Doch dieser Wunsch kann nur mit einem besonderen Apparat erfüllt werden.

Die Kinder aus dem Dorf des Weihnachtsmannes wollen ihm etwas schenken. Gemeinsam mit den Elfen überlegen sie, was ihn erfreuen könnte. Ein Zufall kommt ihnen zu Hilfe: Grantelbart hat seinen Gehilfen Gugor dazu angestiftet, zwei äußerst gefräßige Termiten im Haus des Weihnachtsmannes auszusetzen. Diese beiden Tierchen haben nun ausgerechnet den guten Anzug aufgefressen …

Der Weihnachtsmann lädt zum Weihnachts-Dankfest ein, das alle hundert Jahre stattfindet. Väterchen Frost, die Lichterkönigin Luccia, die Hexe Roxana und die Sternenstaub-Streuerin sind mit von der Partie. Der Weihnachtsmann zaubert mitten am Nordpol einen Strand und ein leckeres Büfett herbei. Grantelbart bekommt von der Feier Wind und ist erbost, weil er nicht eingeladen ist.

Torg und Zilka, zwei Kinder aus dem fernen Scomland, in dem es keine Elfen gibt, wollen gerne mehr über die geheimnisvollen Wesen wissen. Trixi, Gilfi und Jordi entwerfen ein elektronisches 3D-Buch für die Kinder und lassen es von der Spielzeug-Maschine herstellen. Leider sabotieren Grantelbart und Gugor ihr Vorhaben.

Gugor leidet unter Grantelbarts Gemeinheiten und wünscht sich einen mechanischen Doppelgänger, der all seine Aufgaben übernimmt. Obwohl der Weihnachtsmann zustimmen müsste, bauen Jordi und Trixi aus Mitgefühl vor Heiligabend einen eigenen Roboter.

Jordi baut einen Teleporter, mit dem man alles und jeden von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren kann. Er überredet die anderen Elfen und den Weihnachtsmann zu einer Testfahrt. Grantelbart, der das Geschehen beobachtet hat, manipuliert den Teleporter, der auch als Zeitmaschine dient, und die Freunde landen im Jahr 2222.

Kinshi ist verzweifelt, denn sie möchte unbedingt größer werden. Jordi möchte sie dabei unterstützen, indem er aus Pfingstrosenblüten einen Wachstumstrank mixt. Da er sich mit der Dosierung nicht auskennt, geht sein Plan nicht auf.

Die Elfen ärgern sich über den Balbo, der mit seiner Ungeschicklichkeit wieder einmal für Chaos in der Spielzeugfabrik gesorgt hat. Sie setzen ihn vor die Tür. Traurig beschließt Balbo, den Nordpol zu verlassen. Er verpackt sich selbst als Präsent und lässt sich per Post zu dem kleinen Pablo schicken, der sich einen Stoffbären gewünscht hat.

Seit zwei Wochen kommt kein einziger Brief mehr beim Weihnachtsmann an. Doch als er bei der Post nachfragt, versichert ihm diese, dass er sie höchstpersönlich gebeten hätte, seine Post an eine andere Adresse zu senden. Es stellt sich heraus, dass ein falscher Weihnachtsmann die Briefe unterschlagen hat. Ob die Elfen dem richtigen Weihnachtsmann dabei helfen können, den Betrüger zu entlarven?

Grantelbart möchte Weihnachten verhindern und entwickelt ein magisches Pulver, mit dem er die Geschenke zum Leben erwecken kann. Kurz darauf veranstalten diese sehr viel Chaos und das Weihnachtsfest ist somit nicht mehr sicher.

Sebastian ist ein kleiner unentschlossener Junge, der jeden Tag seinen Wunschzettel ändert. Deshalb stapeln sich schon Dutzende von unnützen Geschenken in der Spielzeugfabrik. Um Sebastians Unentschlossenheit ein Ende zu bereiten, sucht ihn der Weihnachtsmann höchstpersönlich auf - doch das hätte er lieber bleiben lassen sollen.

Der Weihnachtsmann, der überall auf der Welt am selben Abend die Geschenke verteilen muss, hat ein Geheimnis: Dank der großen Uhr kann er die Zeit anhalten. Aber als der Weihnachtsmann und die Elfen mit dem Schlitten unterwegs sind, dreht Grantelbart den Verlauf der Zeit um und unsere Helden rasen geradewegs in die Vergangenheit.

Der Weihnachtsmann und die Elfen haben es geschafft, der Vergangenheit zu entkommen. Doch als sie gerade die Geschenke in der Gegenwart verteilen wollen, spielt Grantelbart schon wieder mit der Zeit. Der Weihnachtsmann muss sich beeilen.
